te caturviśatirbhaktyā jinendrā bhaktitatparaiḥ | vanyante'smābhirityevaṃ tevātevā dhvani puraḥ ||10|| kṛtvā purāṇavastūni gātumusphullalocanāḥ | gammīrabhāratītānāsaktāścāraṇayoṣitaḥ ||101|| dhvanimaśrutapūrva taṃ śrutvā tāsāṃ narādhipaḥ | ājagāma guṇākṛṣṭaḥ kāṣṭhabhāra ivodake ||102|| tato recakamādāya lalitāṅgavivartanam | nṛpasyāmimukhīmāvaṃ jagāma varavartanī ||103|| sasmitālokitaistasyā vigaladdhṛsamudgamaiḥ | gamakānugataiḥ kampaistanabhārasya hāriṇaḥ ||104|| mantharaiścārusaṃcārairjaghanasya ghanasya ca | tathā bāhulatāhāraiḥ sulolakarapallavaiḥ ||105|| pādanyāsailaghuspṛṣṭavimuktadharaṇītalaiḥ | āśu saṃpāditaḥ sthānaiḥ keśapāśavivartanaḥ ||106|| trikasya balanarmāgagātrasaṃdarśitātmamiḥ | kāmabāṇairimarlokaḥ sakalaḥ samatāḍyata ||107|| mūrchanābhiḥ svaraimaryathāsthānaṃ niyojitaiḥ | nartakī sā jagau valgu parilīnasakhīsvaram ||10|| yatra tatra samuddeśe nartakī kurute sthitim | tatra tatra sabhā sarvā nayanāni prayacchati ||109|| tasyā rūpeṇa caḍhūṃṣi svareṇa śravaṇendriyam | manāṃsi tavayenāpi vaddhāni sadaso dṛḍham ||110|| utphuktamukharājīvā sāmantā dānatatparā | babhūvurniralaṃkārā saṃvyānāmbaradhāriṇaḥ ||11|| 'ātodyānugataṃ nṛtyaṃ tattasyāstridaśānapi | vaśīkurvīta kaivāsthā suhareṣvanyajantuṣu ||112||
tadanantara jinake netrakamala vikasita the tathā jo bhāratīkī gambhīra tāna khīṃcane meṃ āsakta thīṃ aisī una nṛtyakāriṇī striyoṃne 'bhaktimeṃ tatpara rahanevālī hama saba caubīsa tīrthaṃkaroṃko bhaktipūrvaka namaskāra karatī haiṃ', yaha kahakara saba prathama 'tevā-levā' yaha avyakta dhvani kī phira purāṇoṃmeṃ pratipādita vastuoṃkā gānā śurū kiyā ||100-101|| una nṛtyakāriṇiyoṃkī aśrutapūrva dhvani sunakara guṇoṃse khiṃcā rājā ativīrya unake pāsa isa taraha ā gayā jisa taraha ki pānīmeṃ guṇa arthāt rassīse khiṃcā kāṣṭhakā bhāra khīṃcanevāleke pāsa ātā hai ||102|| tadanantara phirakī lekara sundara aṃgoṃko moḍa़tī hue śreṣṭha nataṃkī rājāke sammukha gayī ||103|| vahāṃ usakā manda-manda musakānake sātha dekhanā, bhauṃhoṃkā calānā, vijña manuṣya ho jise samajha pāte the aise sundara stanoṃkā kaṃpānā, dhīmī-dhīmī sundara cālase calanā, sthūla nitambakā maṭakānā, bhujārūpa latāoṃkā calānā, uttama līlāke sātha hastarūpī pallavoṃkā kirānā, jinameṃ śīghratāse sparśa kara pṛthivītala choḍa़ diyā jātā thā aise paira rakhanā, śīghratāse natyakī aneka mudrāoṃkā badalanā, keśapāśakā calānā, kaṭikī asthikā hilānā, tathā nābhi ādi śarīrake avayavoṃkā dikhalānā ādi kāmake bāṇoṃse samasta manuṣya tāḍa़e gaye the||104-107|| vaha nartakī, jinakā yathāsthāna prayoga kiyā gayā thā aisī mūcchanāoṃ, svaroṃ tathā grāmoṃ-svaroṃke samūhase sakhiyoṃke svarako apane svarameṃ milākara bahuta sundara gā rahī thī ||108||
vaha nṛtyakāriṇī jisa-jisa sthānameṃ ṭhaharatī thī sārī sabhā usī-usī sthānameṃ apane netra lagā detī thī ||109|| sārī sabhāke netra usake rūpase, kāna madhura svarase aura mana, rūpa tathā svara donoṃse majabūta ba~dha gaye the ||110|| jinake mukhakamala vikasita the aise sāmanta loga una nataṃkiyoṃko puraskāra dete-dete alaṃkārarahita ho gaye the unake śarīrapara kevala pahananeke vastra hī bākī raha gaye the ||111|| gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! gāyana-vādanase sahita usa nṛtyakāriṇīkā vaha nṛtya devoṃko bhī vaśa kara sakatā thā phira jinakā harā jānā sarala

vidhāya vṛṣabhādīnāṃ caritasya prakīrtanam | saṃkṣepeṇa vaśīkṛtya samitiṃ sakalāṃ bhṛśam || 113 || saṃgītena samudyuktā rājānamiti nartakī | dadhānā paramāṃ dīptimupālabdhuṃ sudussaham || 114|| ativīryaṃ kimetatte duṣṭaṃ vyavasitaṃ mahat | nayahīnamidaṃ vastu tenātra tvaṃ niyojitaḥ || 115 || kimiti svavināśāya kekayānandanastvayā | śāntacetāḥ śṛgālena kesarīva prakopitaḥ || 116|| evaṃ gate'pi bibhrāṇaḥ paramaṃ vinayaṃ drutam | saṃprasādaya taṃ gavā yadi te jīvitaṃ priyam || 117 || jātā viśuddhavaṃśeṣu varakrīḍanabhūmayaḥ | mābhūvan vidhavā bhadra tavaitā varayoṣitaḥ ||118|| etāstvayā parityaktā vimuktāśeṣabhūṣaṇāḥ | dhruvaṃ purā na śobhante tārācandramasā yathā || 119 || nivartaya dutaṃ cittamaśubhadhyānatatparam | uttiṣṭha vraja nirmāṇo namasya bharataṃ sudhīḥ ||120|| evaṃ kuru na cedevaṃ kuruṣe puruṣādhama | tato'dyaiva vinaṣṭo'si saṃśayo'tra na vidyate || 121 || jīvasyevānaraṇyasya pautre rājyaṃ samīhase | cakāsati ravau pāpalakṣmīrdoṣākarasya kā || 122 || patitasyādya no rūpe maraṇaṃ te samudgatam | śalabhasyeva mūḍhasya duṣpakṣasya priyadyuteḥ || 123|| devena bharatenāmā garuḍena mahātmanā | ' alagadadhimo bhūtvā pratispardhanamicchati || 124|| tato nirbhartsanaṃ svasya bharatasya ca śaṃsanam | niśamya saṃsadā sākamabhūttāmrekṣaṇo nṛpaḥ || 125 || viraktā ca sabhātyantaparaṃ rūkṣitamānasā | jughūrṇārṇavaveleva taraṅgasamākulā ||126 ||
bāta thī aise anya manuṣyoṃkī to bāta hī kyā thī ? ||11|| isa taraha saṃkṣepase ṛṣabha ādi tīrthaṃkaroṃke caritrakā kīrtana kara jaba usa nartakīne samasta sabhāko atyanta vaśībhūta kara liyā taba vaha saṃgītase parama dīptiko dhāraṇa karatī huī rājāko isa prakārakā asahya ulāhanā deneke lie tatpara huī || 113 - 114 || usane kahā ki he ativīryaṃ ! yaha terī atiśaya duṣṭa ceṣṭā kyā hai ? terā yaha kārya nītise rahita hai, kisane tujhe isa kārya meṃ lagāyā hai ? ||115|| jisa taraha śṛgāla siṃhako kupita karatā hai usa taraha tūne śānta citta bharatako apanā nāśa karaneke lie isa taraha kyoṃ kupita kiyā hai ? | | 116 || itanā saba honepara bhī yadi tujhe apanā jīvana pyārā hai to śīghra hī parama vinayako dhāraṇa karatā huā jākara bharatako prasanna kara || 117 || he bhadra ! viśuddha, kulameṃ utpanna tathā uttama krīḍa़ākī bhūmisvarūpa terī ye striyā~ vidhavā na hoṃ ||| 118|| tujhase rahita honepara jinane samasta ābhūṣaṇa choḍa़ diye haiṃ aisī ye uttama striyā~ candramāse rahita tārāoṃke samāna niścita hī śobhita nahīṃ hoṃgī || 119 || isalie aśubha dhyāna meṃ jānevāle apane cittako śīghra hī loṭā, uṭha, jā aura mānarahita ho bharatako namaskāra kara | tū buddhimān hai ||120 || ataḥ aisā kara | he adhama puruṣa ! yadi tū aisā nahīṃ karatā hai to āja hī naṣṭa ho jāyegā isameṃ saṃśaya nahīṃ hai || 121 || anaraṇyake potā bharatake jīvita rahate hīṃ tū rājya cāhatā hai so sūryake dedīpyamāna rahate candramāko kyā śobhā hai ? || 122 || jisa prakāra kāntike lobhī tathā kamajora paṃkhoṃvāle mūrkha śalabhakā maraṇa ā pahu~catā hai usī prakāra hama logoṃke rūpapara āsakta tathā khoṭe sahāyakoṃse yukta tujha mūḍha़kā āja maraṇa ā pahu~cā hai || 123 || tū jalake sā~pake samāna tuccha hokara bhī garuḍa़ke samāna jo mahātmā rājā bharata haiṃ unake sātha īrṣyā karanā cāhatā hai || 124||
tadanantara nṛtyakāriṇīke mukhase apanā tarjana aura bharatakī praśaṃsā sunakara rājā ativīryaṃ sabhāke sātha lāla-lāla netroṃkā dhāraka ho gayā arthāt krodhavaśa usake netra lāla ho gaye || 125 || jisakā mana atyanta rūkṣa ho gayā thā, jisakā prema samāpta ho cukā thā aura jo bhrakuṭirūpo taraṃgoṃ se vyākula thī aisī sārī sabhā samudrako velāke samāna kṣobhako prāpta huī || 126 ||
1. sanmati ma. | 2. mupalabdhuṃ ma | 3. māna-rahitaḥ | 4. alagardo jalavyālaḥ | 5. paruṣakṣatamānasā ma. |

ativīryo ruṣā kampo yāvajjagrāha sāyakam | tāvadutpatya nartakyā savilāsakṛtabhramam ||127|| maṇḍalāgraṃ samākṣipya vīkṣamāṇeṣu rājasu | jīvagrāhaṃ viṣaṇṇātmā keśeṣu jagṛhe dṛḍham ||128|| udyamya nartako khaḍgaṃ paśyantī nṛpasaṃhatim | jagādāvinayī yo'tra sa me vadhyo visaṃśayam ||129|| parityajyātivīryasya pakṣaṃ vinayamaṇḍanāḥ | bharatasya drutaṃ pādau namata priyajīvitāḥ ||130|| marato jayati śrīmān guṇasphītāṃśumaṇḍalaḥ | daśasyandanavaṃśendulkānandakaraḥ paraḥ ||13|| lakṣmīkumudatī yasya vikāsaṃ bhajate tarām | dviṣattapananirmuktā kurvataḥ paramādbhutam ||132|| ujagāma tato lokavaktrebhya iti nisvaraḥ | aho vṛttamidaṃ citramindrajālopamaṃ mahat ||133|| yasya cāraṇakanyānāmidamīdagviceṣṭitam | bharatasya svayaṃ tasya śaktiḥ śakraṃ jayedapi ||134|| na viśnaḥ sa kimasmākaṃ ṛddho nāthaḥ kariṣyati | athavā sapraṇāmeṣu devo yāsyati mārdavam ||135|| tataḥ kariṇamāruhya rāghavaḥ sātivīyakaḥ | sahitaḥ parivargeṇa yayau jinavarālayam ||136|| avatīrya gajāttatra praviśya pramadānvitaḥ | cakre sumahatī pūjāṃ kṛtamaṅgalanisvanaḥ ||137|| varadharmāpi sarveṇa saṃghena sahitāparam | rāghaveṇa sasītena nītā tuṣṭena pūjanam ||138|| ativīryo'tra pabhena lakṣmaṇāya samarpitaḥ | tasyāsau vadhamudyuktaḥ kartumaucyata' sītayā ||139|| māvīvadho'sya lakṣmīman kandharāṃ niṣṭhurāśaya | keśeṣu māgṛhīrgāḍhaṃ kumāraṃ bhaja saumyatām ||140|| ko doṣaḥ karmasāmarthyādyadāyāntyāpadaṃ narāḥ| rakṣyā eva tathāpyete dadhatāmatisādhutām ||14||
krodhase kā~pate hue ativīyaṃne jyoṃhī talavāra uṭhāyo tyoṃhī nataṃkīne vilāsapūrvaka vibhrama dikhāte hue uchalakara talavāra chīna lo aura saba rājāoṃke dekhate-dekhate ativīryako jīvita pakaḍa़kara majabūtīse usake keśa bāṃdha liye ||127-128|| nataṃkīne talavāra uṭhākara rājāoṃkī ora dekhate hue kahā ki yahāṃ jo bhī avinaya karegā vaha niḥsandeha mere dvārā hogā ||129|| yadi āpa logoṃko apanā jīvana pyārā hai to ativīryakā pakṣa choḍa़kara vinayarūpo ābhūṣaṇase yukta ho śīghra hī bharatake caraṇoṃmeṃ namaskāra karo ||130|| jo lakṣmīse yukta hai, guṇa hī jisakī vistṛta kiraṇoṃkā samūha hai, jo logoṃko parama ānandakā denevālā hai, jisakī lakṣmīrūpī kumudinī śatrurūpī sūryase nirmukta hokara parama vikāsako prāpta ho rahī hai tathā jo atyanta āścaryajanaka kārya kara rahā hai aisā daśarathake vaṃśakā candramā bharata jayavanta hai ||131--132||
tadanantara logoṃke mukhase isa prakārake śabda nikalane lage ki aho! yaha baḍa़ā āścarya hai, yaha to bahuta bhārī indrajālake samāna hai ||133|| jisakī nṛtyakāriṇiyoṃkī yaha aisī ceṣṭā hai usa bharatakī śaktikā kyā ṭhikānā ? vaha to indrako bhī jīta legā ||134|| na jāne vaha rājā bharata kapita hokara hamārā kyā karegā? athavā praṇāma karanevāloṃpara vaha avaśya hī mārdavabhāvako prāpta hogā ||135|| tadanantara rāma ativīryako pakaḍa़ hāthīpara savāra ho apane parijanake sātha jinamandira gaye ||136|| vahāṃ unhoṃne hāthīse utarakara baḍa़e harṣase mandirake bhītara praveśa kiyā
aura maṃgalamaya śabdoṃkā uccāraṇa kara baḍa़ī bhārī pūjā kī ||137|| mandira meṃ sarvasaṃghake sātha jo varadharmā nāmakī gaṇinī ṭhaharī huī thīṃ rāmane sītāke sātha santuṣṭa hokara unakī bhī uttama pūjā kī ||138|yahā~ rāmane ativīryako lakṣmaṇake lie sauṃpa diyā aura ve usakā vadha karaneke lie udyata hue taba sītāne kahā ki he lakṣmīdhara ! niṣṭhura abhiprāyake dhārī ho isakī grīvā mata chedo aura na jorase isake keśa hī pakaḍa़o| he kumāra ! saumyatāko prāpta hoo ||139-140|| isa becārekā kyā doṣa hai ? yadyapi manuṣya karmokī sāmayaṃse āpattiko prāpta hote haiṃ tathāpi sajjanatāko dhāraṇa karanevāle manuṣya unakī rakṣā hī karate haiṃ ||141|| 1. sahitaḥ ma. | 2. bhaṇitaṃ | 3. sādhunā ma. |

itaro'pi khīkatu sādhūnāṃ nocito janaḥ | kimutāyaṃ nareśānāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ prapūjitaḥ || 142 || kurvenaṃ muktakaṃ bhadra bhavatāyaṃ vaśīkṛtaḥ | jānānaḥ svasya sāmathyaṃ kvānugacchati sāṃpratam ||143|| gṛhītvā samayenāsya sanmānamupalambhitāḥ | vimucyante punarbhūyo maryādeyaṃ cirantanī ||144|| ityukto mastake kṛtvā kararājīvakuḍmalam | jagāda lakṣmaṇo devi yadbravīṣi tathaiva tat || 145|| āstāṃ svāmini te vākyāttāvadasya vimocanam | surāṇāmapyamuṃ pūjyaṃ kurvīyaṃ tvatprasādataḥ || 146 || evaṃ praśāntasaṃrambhe sadyo lakṣmīdhare sthite | ativīryo vibuddhātmā stutvā padmamabhāṣata || 147 || sādhu sādhu tvayā citraṃ kṛtamīdṛgviceṣṭitam | kadācidapyanutpannā mamādya matirudgatā || 148 || vimuktahāramukuṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ karuṇānvitaḥ | viśrabdhaṃ rāghavo'vocat saumyākāraparigrahaḥ || 149 || mā vajīraṅga dainyaṃ tvaṃ dhatsva dhairyaṃ purātanam | mahatāmeva jāyante saṃpado vipadanvitāḥ || 150 || na cātra kācidāpatte naṃdyāvarte kramāgate | bharatasya vaśo bhūtvā kuru rājyaṃ yathepsitam || 151|| ativīryastato'vocanna me rājye'dhunā spṛhā | rājyena me phalaṃ dattamadhunānyatra sajjyate ||152|| āsīnmayā kṛtā vāṃchā himavatsāgarāvadhi | jetuṃ vasundharā yena bibhratā mānamuttamam ||153|| so'haṃ svamānamunmūlya bhūtvā sāravivarjitaḥ | kuryāṃ praṇatimanyasya kathaṃ puruṣatāṃ dadhat || 154|| ṣaṭkhaṇḍā 'yairapi kṣoṇī pāliteyaṃ mahānaraiḥ | na tṛptāste'pyahaṃ grāmaḥ pañcabhistu kimetakaiḥ || 155 || janmāntarakṛtasyāsya balitāṃ paśya karmaṇaḥ | chāyāhānimahaṃ yena rāhuṇendurivāhṛtaḥ ||156||
jo sajjana puruṣa haiṃ unheṃ sādhāraṇa manuṣyako bhī duḥkhī karanā ucita nahīṃ hai phira yaha to hajāroṃ rājāoṃkā pūjya hai isakī bāta ho kyā hai ? || 142 || he bhadra ! ise āpane vaśa kara hī liyā hai ataḥ ise choḍa़ do | apanī sāmarthyako jānatā huā yaha aba kahā~ jāyegā ? ||143|| prabala śatruoṃ ko pakaḍa़kara tadanantara sandhike anusāra sammāna kara unheṃ choḍa़ diyā jātā hai yaha cirakālakī maryādā hai || 144||
165
sītā isa prakāra kahanepara lakṣmaṇane hastakamala joḍa़ mastakapara lagāte hue kahā ki he devi ! āpa jo kaha rahī haiṃ vaha vaisā hī hai || 145 || he svāmini, āpakī ājñāse isakā choḍa़nā tara rahā ise āpake prasādase aisā kara sakatā hū~ ki yaha devatāoṃkā bhī pūjya ho jāye || 146|| isa prakāra śīghra hī lakṣmaṇake śānta honepara pratibodhako prāpta huā ativīryaṃ rāmakī stuti kara kahane lagā || 147 || ki āpane jo yaha adbhuta ceṣṭā kī so baḍa़ā bhalā kiyā| merī jo buddhi kabhī utpanna nahīṃ huī vaha āja utpanna ho gayī || 148 || itanā kaha usane hāra aura mukuṭa utārakara rakha diye | yaha dekha saumya ākārako dhāraṇa karanevāle dayālu rāmane viśvāsa dilāte hue kahā ki he bhadra ! tū dīnatāko prāpta mata ho, pahale jaisā dhairyaṃ dhāraṇa kara, vipattiyoṃse sahita sampadāe~ mahāpuruṣoṃko hī prāpta hotī haiṃ ||149 - 150 | aba mujhe koī āpatti nahīṃ hai ! isa kramāgata nandyāvartanagarameṃ bharatakā ājñākārī hokara icchānusāra rājya kara || 151 ||
tadanantara ativīryaṃne kahā ki aba mujhe rājyakī icchā nahīṃ hai | rājyane mujhe phala de diyā hai | aba dūsare hī avasthā meṃ laganā cāhatā hū~ || 152 || utkaṭa mānako dhāraṇa karate hue maiṃne himavānse lekara samudra takakī sārī pṛthivī jītane kī icchā kī tho so maiṃ apane mānako ukhāḍa़kara niḥsāra ho gayā hū~ aba maiṃ puruṣatvako dhāraṇa karatā huā anyako namaskāra kaise kara sakatā hū~ ? || 153 - 154 || jina mahāpuruṣoṃne isa chahakhaṇḍakī rakṣā kī hai ve bhī santoṣako prāpta nahīṃ hue phira ina pāṃca gāṃvoṃse kaise santuṣṭa ho sakatā hū~ ? ||155|| janmāntara meṃ kiye hue isa karmakī balavattā
1. itaro ye ma. | 2. nandyāvarte kramāgate ma., nandyāvartakamāgate kha. |

padmapurāṇe
mānuṣyakamidaṃ jātaṃ sāramuktaṃ mayādhunā | surāṇāmapi vārteṣā kimanyatrābhidhīyatām ||157|| so'haṃ punarbhavādbhīrustvayā saṃpratibodhitaḥ | tathāvidhāṃ maje ceṣṭāṃ yayā muktiravāpyate || 158 || ityuktvā kṣamayitvā taṃ parivargasamanvitam | gatvā kesarivikrānto muniṃ śrutidharaśrutim || 159|| karābjakuḍmalāṅkena vidhāya śirasā natim | jagāda nātha vāñchāmi dīkṣāṃ daigambarīmiti || 160 | ācāryeṇaivamityukte parityajyāṃśukādikam | keśaluñcaṃ vidhāyāsau mahāvratadharo'bhavat ||161|| ātmārthaniratastyaktarāgadveṣaparigrahaḥ | vijahāra kṣitiṃ dhīro yatrāstamitavāsyasau || 162 || krūraśvāpadayukteṣu gahaneṣu vaneṣu saḥ | cakāra vasatiṃ nirbhīrgahvareṣu ca bhūbhṛtām || 163 || upajātiḥ vimuktaniśśeṣaparigrahāśaṃ gṛhītacāritrabharaṃ suśīlam |
166
nānātapaḥ śoṣitadehamuddhaṃ mahāmuniṃ taṃ namatātivīryam ||164|| ratnatrayāpāditacārubhūṣaṃ digambaraṃ sādhuguṇāvataṃsam | saṃprasthitaṃ yogyavaraṃ vimuktermahāmuni taṃ namatātivīryam ||165|| idaṃ paraṃ ceṣṭitamātivīryaṃ śṛṇoti yo yaśca sudhīradhīte |
prāpnoti vṛddhiṃ sadaso'pi madhye raviprabho'sau vyasanaṃ na lokaḥ ||166|| ityāe~ ra viṣeṇācāryaprokte padmacarite'tivīryaniṣkramaṇābhidhānaṃ nāma saptatriṃśattamaṃ parva || 37 ||
to dekho ki jisa prakāra rāhu candramāko kāntirahita kara detā hai usī prakāra isane mujhe kāntirahita - nisteja kara diyā || 156 || jisa manuṣya paryāyake lie deva bhī carcā karate haiṃ auroṃkī to
hī kyā hai usa manuṣya paryāyako maiṃne aba taka niḥsāra khoyā || 157|| aba maiṃ dūsarā janma dhāraṇa karane se bhayabhīta ho cukā hū~ isalie āpase pratibodha pākara yaha ceṣṭā karatā hū~ ki jisase mukti prāpta hotī hai || 158|| isa prakāra kahakara parijana sahita rāmase kṣamā karākara siṃhake samāna śūravīratāko dhāraṇa karatā huā ativīyaṃ śrutidhara munirājake pāsa gayā aura aṃjaliyukta śirase namaskāra kara bolā ki he nātha ! maiṃ daigambarī dīkṣā dhāraṇa karanā cāhatā hū~ || 159-160 || 'evamastu' isa prakāra ācāryaṃke kahate hī vaha vastrādi tyāgakara tathā keśa loṃcakara mahāvratakā dhārī ho gayā || 161|| ātmāke artha meṃ tatpara, tathā rāga-dveṣa ādi parigrahase rahita hokara vaha dhīra-vīra pṛthivīmeṃ vihāra karane lagā | vihāra karate-karate jahā~ sūrya asta ho jātā thā vahīṃ vaha ṭhahara jātā thā || 162|| siṃha ādi duṣṭa jānavaroṃse yukta saghana vanoṃ tathā parvatoṃkī guphāoṃ meṃ vaha nirbhaya hokara nivāsa karatā thā || 163|| jisane samasta parigrahakī āśā choḍa़ dī thī, jisane cāritrakā bhāra dhāraṇa kiyā thā, jo uttama śīlase yukta thā, nānā prakāra ke tapase jisane apanā śarīra sukhā diyā, tathā jo svayaṃ śubha rūpa thā una mahāmuni ativīryako namaskāra karo ||164|| samyagdarśana, samyagjñāna aura samyak cāritrarūpī manohara ābhūṣaṇoṃse jo sahita the, diśāe~ hī jinake ambara -- vastra the, muniyoṃke aṭṭhāīsa mūla guṇa hī jinake ābharaṇa the, jinhoṃne karmarūpī śatruoṃ ko haraneke lie prasthāna kiyā thā, aura jo mukti ke yogya vara the una mahāmuni ativīryako namaskāra karo ||165|| | gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! ativīryaṃ munike isa utkṛṣṭa caritako jo buddhimān sunatā hai athavā paḍha़tā hai vaha sabhāke bīca buddhiko prāpta hotā hai tathā sūryake samāna prabhāko dhāraṇa karatā huā kabhī kaṣṭa nahīṃ pātā ||166 ||
isa prakāra ārṣa nāmase prasiddha, raviṣeṇācārya kathita padmacarita meṃ rājā ativīrya kī dīkṣākā varṇana karanevālā saiṃtīsavā~ parva samāpta huā ||37||

aṣṭatriṃśattamaṃ parva
atha padmo'tivīryasya tanayaṃ nayakovidaḥ | vijayasyandanāmikhyamabhyaṣiñcatpituḥ pade ||1|| darśitāśeṣavitto'sāvaravindātanūbhuvam | svasāraṃ ratisālākhyāṃ lakṣmaṇāya nyavedayat ||2|| evamastvityamīṣṭāyāṃ ' tasyāṃ pajhena lakṣmaṇaḥ | lakṣmīmivāṅkamāyātāṃ jñātvā sapramado'bhavat ||3|| tataḥ kṛtvā jinendrāṇāṃ pūjāṃ vismayadāyinīm | iyāya vijayasthānaṃ lakṣmaṇādyanvito balaḥ ||4|| dīkṣāṃ śrutvātivīryasya natakīgrahahetukāṃm | śatrughnaṃ hāsasadhvānaṃ niṣidhya bharato'vadat ||5|| ativīryo mahādhanyastasya kiṃ bhadra hāsyate | tyaktvā yo viṣayān kaṣṭāna para śāntimupāśritaḥ ||6|| prabhāvaṃ tapasaḥ paśya tridaśeṣvapi durlabham | muniyoṃ ripurāsīnnaḥ saṃprāpto'sau praṇamyatām ||7|| ślāghāmityativīryasya yāvakurvan sa tiṣṭhati | vijayasyandanastāvatprāptaḥ sāmantamadhyagaḥ ||8|| praṇamya maratāyāsau sthitaḥ saṃkathayā kṣaṇam | jyāyasī ratimālāyā nāmnā vijayasundarīm ||9|| upaninye śubhāṃ kanyāṃ nānālaṃkāradhāriṇīm | kośaṃ ca vipulaṃ sāraṃ sādhanaṃ ca prasannadṛk ||10|| kanyāmekāmupādāya kekayānandanastataḥ | tasyaivānumataṃ sarva sthitireṣā mahātmanām ||11|| kautukotkalikākīrṇamānaso'tha mahājavaiḥ | aśvaiḥ pravavṛte draṣṭumativīrya digambaram ||12|| kvāsau mahāmuniḥ kvāsāviti pṛcchansubhāvanaḥ | eṣo'yamityamuṃ bhṛtyaiḥ kathyamānamiyāya saḥ ||13||
athānantara nyāyake vettā śrīrāmane ativīryake putra vijayarathakā usake pitāke padapara abhiṣeka kiyā ||1|| usane apanā saba dhana dikhāyā aura mātā aravindākī putrī apanī ratnamālā nāmaka bahana lakṣmaṇake lie denī kahī so rāmane use 'evamastu' kahakara svīkṛta kiyā| ratnamālāko pā, māno lakṣmī hī godameṃ āyo hai, yaha jānakara lakṣmaṇa adhika prasanna hue ||2-3|| tadanantara lakṣmaṇa ādise sahita rāma, jinendra bhagavānkī āścaryadāyinī pūjā kara rājā pṛthvīdharake vijayapura nagara vāpasa āye ||4|| nartakīke pakaḍa़neke kāraṇa rājā ativīryane dīkṣā dhāraṇa kī hai yaha sunakara śatrughna hāsya karane lagā so bharatane manā kara kahā ||5|| ki he bhadra ! jo kaṣṭakārī viṣayoṃko choḍa़kara parama śāntiko prāpta huā hai aisā ativīrya mahādhanya hai| usakī tū kyā haṃsī karatā hai ? ||6|| jo devoṃke lie bhī durlabha hai aisā tapakā prabhāva dekha | jo hamārā śatru thā aba muni honepara vaha hamāre namaskāra karane yogya guru ho gayā ||7| isa prakāra ativīryako praśaṃsā karatā haā bharata jabataka baiṭhā thā tabataka aneka sāmantoṃke sātha vijayaratha vahā~ ā paha~cā ||8|| vaha bharatako praṇāma kara uttama vārtā karatā huā kṣaṇa bhara baiṭhā| tadanantara usane ratimālāko baḍa़ī bahana vijayasundarī nāmakī śubha kanyā jo ki nānā alaṃkāroṃko dhāraṇa kara rahī thī bharatake lie samarpita kī| sātha hī baḍa़ī prasanna dṛṣṭise bahuta bhārī khajānā aura uttama senā bhī pradāna kī ||9-10|| tadanantara usa advitīya kanyāko pākara bharata bahuta prasanna huā| usane vijayarathakī icchānukūla saba kārya svīkṛta kiyā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki mahāpuruṣoṃko yahī rīti hai ||11||
athānantara jisakā mana kautuka aura utkaṇṭhāse vyāpta thā aisā bharata mahāvegaśālī ghoḍa़oṃse ativīrya manirājake darśana karaneke lie calā ||12|| vaha uttama bhāvanāse sahita thā tathā pūchatā jātā thā ki ve mahāmuni kahā~ haiṃ ? aura sevaka kahate jāte the ki ye āge virājamāna haiṃ ||13||
1. svīkṛtāyām | 2. saharṣo'bhūt | 3. rāmaḥ | 4. kaṣṭāṃ ka., kha. |

papurāṇe tato viṣamapāṣāṇanivahāsyantadurgamam | nānāgumasamākīrṇa kusumāmodavāsitam ||14|| tajjñena kathitaṃ ramyaṃ parvataṃ śvāpadākulam | ārurohāvatīryāśvādvinītākāramaṇḍitaḥ ||15|| roṣatoṣavinirmuktaṃ praśāntakaraṇaṃ vibhum | śilātalaniṣaṇṇaṃ tamekasiṃhamivābhayam ||16|| ativīryamuni dṛṣṭā sughoratapasi sthitam | śumadhyānagatātmānaṃ jvalantaṃ śramaṇaśriyā ||17|| utphullanayano lokaḥ sarvo hṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ | vismayaṃ paramaṃ prāpto nanāma racitāñjaliḥ ||18|| kṛtvāsya mahatīṃ pūjā bharataḥ śramaṇapriyaḥ | praṇamya pādayorūce bhaktyā vinatavigrahaḥ ||19|| nātha śūrastvamevaikaḥ paramārthaviśāradaḥ | yeneyaṃ durdharā dīkṣā ghṛtā jinavaroditā ||20|| viśuddhakulajātānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ mahātmanām | jñātasaṃsārasārāṇāmīdṛgeva viceṣṭitam ||21|| manuṣyalokamāsādya phalaṃ yadamivānchayate | tadupāttaṃ tvayā sādho vayamatyantaduḥkhinaḥ ||22|| kṣantavyaṃ duritaṃ kiṃcidyadasmābhistvayīhitam | kṛtārtho'si namastubhyaṃ prāptāyātipratīkṣyatām ||23|| ityuktvā sāñjaliṃ kṛtvā mahāsādhoḥ pradakṣiṇām | avatīrṇaḥ kathāṃ maunī kurvāṇo dharaṇīdharāt ||24|| sthūrīpṛṣṭhaṃ samāruhya pūryamāṇaḥ sahasraśaḥ| sāmantaiḥ prasthito'yodhyā vibhavāmbhodhimadhyagaḥ ||25|| mahāsādhanasāmantamaṇḍalasyāntare sthitaḥ | śuśubhe'sau yadhā jambūdvīpo'nyadvīpamadhyamaḥ ||26|| ka gatāstā nu nartakyaḥ kṛtalokānurajanāḥ | svajīvite'pi vilomā vidadhuryā mayi priyam ||27||
tadanantara jo ūṃce-nīce pāṣāṇoṃke samūhase atyanta durgama thā, nānā prakārake vṛkṣoṃse vyāpta thā, phūloṃkī sugandhise suvāsita thā, aura jaṃgalī jānavaroṃse yukta thā aise jānakāra sevakoṃke dvārā batāye hue parvatapara bharata caḍha़ā aura ghoḍa़ese utarakara vinīta veṣase śobhita hotā huā ativīrya munirājake darśanake lie calā| ||14-15|| ve munirāja harṣa-viṣādase rahita the, śānta indriyoṃke dhāraka the. vibha the. śilātalapara virājamāna the. eka siṃhake samāna nirbhaya the. ghora tapameṃ sthita the, śubha dhyānameṃ līna the aura munipanekī lakṣmīse dedīpyamāna the ||16-17|| munirājake darśana kara saba logoṃke netra vikasita ho gaye aura sabake śarīrameṃ harṣase romāṃca nikala āye| sabhīne parama āścaryako prāpta ho aṃjali joḍa़kara unheṃ namaskāra kiyā ||18|| jise muni bahuta priya the aise bharatane una munirājakī baḍa़ī bhārī pūjā kī, caraṇoṃmeṃ praṇāma kiyā aura phira bhaktise nataśarīra hokara isa prakāra kahā ki he nātha! jisane yaha jinendra-pratipādita kaṭhina dīkṣā dhāraṇa ko hai aise eka āpa hī śūravīra ho tathā āpa hī paramārthake jānanevāle ho ||19-20|| viśuddha kulameṃ utpanna tathā saṃsārake sārako jānanevāle mahāpuruṣoṃkī aisī hī ceṣṭā hotī hai ||21|| manuṣya loka pākara jisa phalakī icchā kī jātī hai he sādho! vaha phala āpane pā liyā para hama atyanta dukhī haiṃ ||22|| he nātha ! hama logoṃse āpake viṣayameṃ jo kucha aniṣṭa-pāparūpa ceṣṭā huī hai use kṣamā kījie| āpa kṛtakṛtya haiṃ, atiśaya pūjyatāko prāpta hue āpake lie hamārā namaskāra hai ||23|| isa prakāra mahāmunirāja ativīryase kahakara tathā aṃjali sahita pradakṣiṇā dekara unhīṃse sambandha rakhanevālī kathā karatā huā bharata parvatase nīce utarā ||24|| tadanantara hajāroṃ sāmanta jisake sātha the tathā jo vibhavarūpī samudrake bīcameṃ gamana kara rahā thā aisā bharata hastinīke pṛṣṭhapara savāra ho ayodhyāke lie vāpasa calā ||25|| baḍī bhārī senā aura sāmantoṃke bīcameṃ sthita bharata aisā suśobhita ho rahā thā māno anya dvīpoṃke madhya meṃ sthita jambūdvīpa hī ho ||26|| bharata prasanna cittase isa prakāra vicāra karatā jātā thā ki jinhoṃne apane jīvanakā bhī lobha choḍa़kara hamārā iṣṭa kiyā aisī logoṃko anuraṃjita karanevālī ve nartakiyā~ kahāṃ gayī hoṃgī? ||27|| rājā 1. vasthitam ma. | 2. duḥkhitāḥ ma.| 3. atipūjyatām | 4. munisaṃbandhinīm | 5. hastinīpṛṣṭham |

puraḥ kṛtvātivīryasya mahīyāṃ paramāṃ stutim | nartakīmiḥ kṛtaṃ karma citrametadaho param ||28|| strīṇāṃ kuto'thavā śaktirīdaśī viṣṭape'khile| jinaśāsanadevīminametadanuṣṭhitam ||29|| cintayanāyamityādi suprasannena cetasā | jagāma dharaṇīṃ paśyannānāsasyasamākulām ||30|| vyāptāśeṣajagatkīrtiḥ prabhāvaṃ paramaṃ dadhat | saśatrughno viveśāsau vinītā paramodayaḥ ||31|| sākaṃ vijayasundaryā tasthau tatra ratiṃ bhajan | sulocanāpariṣvakto yathā jaladanisvanaḥ ||32|| ānandaṃ sarvalokasya kurvāṇī rāmalakṣmaṇau | kaṃcitkālaṃ pure sthitvā pṛthivīdharabhabhṛtaḥ ||33|| jānakyā saha saṃmanya kartavyāhitamānasau | bhūyaḥ prasthātumudyuktau samuddeśamabhīpsitam ||34|| vanamālā tato'vocallakṣmaṇaṃ cārulakṣaṇā | savāṣpe bibhratī netre tarattaralatārake ||35|| avaśyaṃ yadi moktavyā mandabhāgyāhakaṃ tvayā | puraiva rakṣitā kasmānmamūrṣantī vada priya ||36|| saumitriragadad bhadre viṣādaṃ mā gamaḥ priye | atyalpenaiva kālena punaremi varānane ||37|| samyagdarśanahīnā yāṃ gatiṃ yānti suvibhrame | bajeyaṃ tāṃ punaḥ kṣipraṃ na cedemi tavāntikam ||30|| narāṇāṃ mānadagdhānāṃ sādhunindanakāriṇām | śiye pāpena lipye'haṃ yadi nāyāmi te'ntikam ||39|| rakṣitavyaṃ piturvākyamasmāmiḥ prāṇavallabhe | dakṣiṇodanvataḥ kūlaṃ gantavyaṃ nirvicāraṇam ||40|| malayopasyakāṃ prāpya kṛtvā paramamālayam | neṣyāmi bhavatīmetya varoru dhṛtimātraja ||41|| samayaiḥ sāntvayitveti vanamālāṃ subhāṣitaiḥ | bheje lāgalinaḥ pāśva sumitrākukṣisaṃbhavaḥ||42||
ativīryake sāmane hamārī parama stuti kara una nartakiyoṃne jo kāma kiyā| aho! vaha baḍa़e āścaryakī bāta hai ||28|| athavā samasta saṃsārameṃ striyoṃkī aisī śakti kahā~ hai ? niścayase yaha kāyaṃ jinaśāsanako deviyoṃne kiyā hai|' tadanantara jo nānā prakārake dhānyase yukta pṛthivīko dekha rahā thā, jisakī kīrti samasta saṃsārameṃ vyāpta thī, jo parama prabhāvako dhāraṇa kara rahā thā aura jo utkṛṣṭa abhyudayase yukta thā aise bharatane śatrughnake sātha ayodhyāmeṃ praveśa kiyā ||29-31|| vahā~ vijayasundarīke sātha prītiko dhāraṇa karatā huā bharata sulocanā sahita meghasvara ( jayakumāra ) ke samāna sukhase rahane lagā ||32||
athānantara saba logoṃko ānanda utpanna karate hue rāma-lakṣmaṇa kucha samaya taka to rājā pṛthivīdharake nagarameṃ rahe phira jānakīke sātha salāha kara āgekā kārya niścita karate hue icchita sthānapara jāneke lie udyata hue ||33-34|| tadanantara jo sundara lakṣaṇoṃse yukta thī aura āṃsuoṃse bhīge caṃcala kanīnikāoṃvāle netra dhāraṇa kara rahī thī aisī vanamālā lakṣmaṇase bolī ki he priya ! yadi mujha mandabhāgyāko tumheṃ avaśya hī choḍa़nā thā to pahale hī maranese kyoṃ bacāyā thā so kaho ||35-36|| taba lakṣmaṇane kahā ki he bhadre ! he priye ! he varānane ! viṣādako prāpta mata hoo| maiṃ bahuta hī thoḍa़e samaya bāda phira ā jāū~gā ||37|| he uttama vilāsoṃko dhāraṇa karanevālī priye! yadi maiṃ śīghra hī tumhāre pāsa vāpasa na āū~ to samyagdarśanase hona manuṣya jisa gatiko prāpta hote haiṃ usī gatiko prāpta ho ||38|| he priye ! yadi maiṃ tumhāre pāsa na āū~ to sādhuoṃkī nindā karanevāle ahaṃkārī manuṣyoṃke pāpase lipta hoū~ ||39|| he prāṇavallabhe! hameṃ pitāke vacanakī rakṣā karanī hai aura binā kucha vicāra kiye dakṣiṇa samudrake taṭa jānā hai ||40|| vahā~ malayācalako upatyakāmeṃ jākara uttama bhavana banāūṃgā aura phira tumheṃ le jāū~gā| he sundara jā~ghoṃvālī priye ! taba taka dhairya dhāraṇa karo ||41|| isa prakāra uttama śabdoṃse yukta śapathoṃke dvārā vanamālāko śānta kara lakṣmaṇa rāmake pāsa jā pahuṃce ||42|| 1. ayodhyām | 2. jayakumāraḥ, meghasvara iti tasyaivāparaṃ nāma | 3. malayāpatyakāṃ ma.| 4. māvata ma.| 5. śapathaiḥ | samagreḥ ma.| 2-22

padmapurāṇe tataḥ suptajane kāle viditau tau na kenacit | nirgatya nagarādgantuṃ pravṛttau saha sītayā ||43|| prabhāte tadvinirmukta puraṃ dṛṣṭvākhilo janaḥ | paramaṃ śokamāpannaḥ kṛcchreṇādhārayattanum ||44|| vanamālā gṛhaṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇena vivarjitam | samayeṣa samālambya jīvitaṃ śokinī sthitā ||45|| viharantau tataḥ kṣoṇī lokavismayakāriṇau | mumudāte mahāsattvau sasītau rāmalakṣmaṇau ||46|| yuvatyujjvalavallīnāṃ manonayanapallavān | tāvanaṅgatuṣāreṇa dahantāvāṭatuḥ śanaiḥ ||47|| kasya puṇyavato gotrametābhyāṃ samalaṃkṛtam | sujātā jananī saikā loke yetāvajījanat ||48|| dhanyeyaṃ vanitaitābhyāṃ samaṃ yā carati kṣitim | īdṛśaṃ yadi devānāṃ rūpaṃ devāstataḥ sphuṭam ||49|| kataḥ samāgatāvetau bajato vā ka sundarau | vāñchataḥ kimimau kā sṛṣṭirīdagiyaṃ katham ||50|| sakhyo'nena pathā dṛṣṭau puṇḍarīkanirīkṣaṇau | brajantau sahitau nāryā kvaciñcandranibhānanau ||51|| yadimau śobhinau mugdhe manuṣyāvathavā surau | tatkimarthaṃ tvayā śoko dhāryate gatalajayā ||52|| ayi muḍhe na puṇyena nitāntaṃ bhūriṇā vinā | labhyate suciraṃ draṣṭumevaṃvidhanarākṛtiḥ ||53|| nivartasva bhaja svāsthyaṃ srastaṃ vasanamuddhara | mā naiṣīrlocane khedamatimātraprasārite ||54|| netramānasacaurābhyāṃ dṛṣṭābhyāmapi bālike | niṣṭhurābhyāṃ kimetābhyāṃ kābhyāmapi tiṃ maja ||55|| ityādyālāpasaṃsaktaṃ kurvāṇāvabalājanam | remāte śuddhacittau tau svecchāvihatikāriṇau ||56|| nānājanapadākīṇoṃ paryaṭya dhariṇīmimau | kṣemāñjalisamākhyānaṃ saṃprāptau parama puram ||57|| udyāne nikaṭe tasya 'jaladotkarasaṃnibhe | avasthitāḥ sukhenaite yathā saumanase surāḥ ||58||
tadanantara jaba saba loga so gaye taba kisīke binā jāne hī rāma lakṣmaṇa aura sītāke sātha nagarase nikalakara āgeke lie cala paḍa़e ||43|| jaba prabhāta huā taba nagarako unase rahita dekha samasta jana parama śokako prāpta hue tathā baḍa़e kaṣṭase śarīrako dhāraṇa kara sake ||44|| vanamālā bhī gharako lakṣmaṇase rahita dekha bahuta śokako prāpta huī tathā lakṣmaṇake dvārā kī huī śapathoṃkā āśraya le jīvita rahī ||45|| tadanantara mahān dhairyake dhāraka rāma-lakṣmaṇa pṛthvīpara vihāra karate hue parama ānandako prāpta hue| unheṃ dekha logoṃko āścarya utpanna hotā thā||46|| ve taruṇa strīrūpī ujjvala latāoṃke mana aura netrarūpī pallavoṃko kāmarūpī tuṣārase jalāte hue dhīre-dhīre vihāra karate the ||47|| he sakhi ! ina donoṃne kisa puṇyātmākā kula alaṃkṛta kiyā hai ? vaha kaunasī bhāgyaśālinī mātā hai jisane ina donoṃko janma diyā hai ? ||48|| yaha strī dhanya hai jo inake sātha pṛthvī para vihāra kara rahī hai| yadi aisā rūpa devoṃkā hotā hai to niścita hī ye deva haiṃ ||49|| ye sundara puruṣa kahā~se āye haiṃ ? kahā~ jā rahe haiṃ ? aura kyā karanā cāhate haiṃ inako yaha
se ho gayī?||50|| jinake netra kamalake samāna tathā makha candramāke tulya hai aise do puruṣa eka strīke sātha isa mārgase jā rahe the so he sakhiyo ! tumane dekhe ||51|| he mugdhe ! ye atiśaya suśobhita vyakti manuṣya hoṃ athavā deva, tū nilaṃjja hokara śoka kisa lie dhāraṇa kara rahī hai ? ||52|| ayi mūrkhe! aise manuṣyoṃkā rūpa bahuta bhārī puṇyake binā cirakāla taka dekhaneko prāpta nahīṃ hotā ||53|| isalie lauṭa jā, svastha ho, nīce khisake hue vastrako sa~bhāla aura atyadhika pasāre hue netroṃko kheda mata prāpta karā ||54!! arī bāle ! netra aura manako curānevāle ina kaṭhora puruṣoṃke dekhanese kyā prayojana hai ? dhīraja dhara ||55|| isa prakāra strījanoṃko vārtālāpa karanemeṃ tatpara karate hue śuddhacittake dhāraka ve donoṃ svecchāse vihāra kara rahe the ||56|| isa prakāra nānā deśoṃse vyāpta pṛthivīmeṃ vihāra karate hue ve kṣemāṃjali nāmake parama sundara nagarameṃ pahuṃce ||57|| usa nagarake nikaṭa hī ve meghasamūhake samāna sundara eka udyānameṃ sukhapūrvaka isa prakāra ṭhahara gaye 1. meghasamūhasadṛśe |

annaṃ varaguṇaṃ bhuktvā lakṣmaṇenopasādhitam | mādhvīkaṃ sītayā sārdhamasevata halāyudhaḥ ||59|| 'prāsādagirimālābhistato hṛtanirīkṣaṇaḥ | lakṣmaṇaḥ padmato'nujñāṃ prāpya praśrayayācitām ||60|| dadhānaḥ pravaraṃ mālyaṃ pītāmbaradharaḥ śubhaḥ | svairaṃ kṣemāñjaliṃ dṛṣṭaṃ pratasthe cāruvibhramaḥ ||6|| nānālatopagūḍhāni kānanāni varāṇyasau| saritaḥ svacchatoyāśca śubhrābhrasamasaikatāḥ ||62|| vicitradhāturaṅgāśca parikrīḍanaparvatān | devadhāmāni tuṅgāni kūpān vāpīḥ sabhāḥ prapāḥ ||63|| lokaṃ ca vividhaṃ paśyan dṛśyamānaḥ savismayam | viveśa nagaraṃ dhīro nānāvyāpārasaṃkulam ||64|| śṛṇu śṛṇvati tatrāyaṃ pradhānaviśikhāgatam | aśṛṇotpaurataḥ śabdamiti viśrabdhabhāṣitam ||65|| puruṣaḥ ko'nvasau loke yo muktāṃ rājapāṇinā | śakti prasahya śūrendro jitapadmo gṛhīṣyati ||66|| svarge rājya dadāmoti rājā cetpratipadyate | tathāpi nānayā kṛtyaṃ kathayā śaktiyātayā ||67|| jātaścābhimukhaḥ śakteḥ prāṇaśca parivarjitaḥ | kiṃ kariṣyati kanyāsya rājyaṃ vā tridaśālaye ||6|| samastebhyo hi vastubhyaḥ priyaṃ jagati jīvitam | tadarthamitarat sarvamiti ko nāvagacchati ||69|| śrutvaivaṃ kautukī kaṃcidatha papraccha mānavam | bhadra ! kā jitapadmayaṃ yadartha bhāṣate janaḥ ||7|| so'vocanmṛtyukanyāsāvatipaṇḍitamāninī | kiṃ na te viditā sarvalokavikhyātakīrtikā ||7|| etannagaranāthasya rājñaḥ taḥ | kanakābhāsamutpannā duhitā guṇaśālinī ||72|| yato'nayā jitaṃ padmaṃ kāntyā vadanajātayā | padmā ca sarvagātreṇa jitapadmoditā tataḥ ||73||
jisa prakāra ki saumanasa vanameṃ deva ṭhahara jāte haiṃ ||58|| vahā~ lakṣmaṇake dvārā taiyāra kiyā uttama bhojana grahaṇa kara rāmane sītāke sātha dākhoṃkā madhura peya diyā ||59||
tadanantara baḍa़e-baḍa़e mahalarūpī parvatoṃkī paṃktiyoṃse jinake netra hare gaye the aise lakṣmaṇa vinayapūrvaka rāmase ājñā prāpta kara icchānusāra kṣemāṃjali nagara dekhaneke lie cale| usa samaya ve uttama mālāe~ aura pītavastra dhāraṇa kiye hue the tathā sundara vilāsase sahita the ||60-61|| nānā latāoṃse āliṃgita uttamottama vanoṃ, svaccha jalase bharī tathā śuklameghoṃke samāna ujjvala taṭoṃse śobhita nadiyoṃ, nānā prakārakī dhātuoṃse raṃga-biraṃge krīḍa़ā-parvatoṃ, ū~ce-ū~ce jinamandira, kuoṃ, vāpikāoṃ, sabhāoṃ, pānīyaśālāoṃ aura aneka prakārake manuṣyoṃko dekhate hue unhoṃne nānā prakārake vyāpāra-kāryoṃse yukta nagarīmeṃ baḍa़ī dhīratāse praveśa kiyā| loga unheṃ baḍa़e āścaryasa dekha rahe the ||62-64| jaba ye nagarake pradhāna mārga meṃ pahuṃce taba unhoṃne kisī nagaravāsīse niścintatāpūrvaka kahā huā yaha śabda sunā ||65|| vaha kisīse kaha rahā thā ki are suno-suno, saṃsārameṃ aisā kauna śūravīra puruṣa hai jo rājāke hāthase choḍa़ī huī śaktiko sahakara 'jitapadmā' kanyāko grahaṇa karegā? ||66|| yadi rājā yaha bhī kahe ki maiṃ svargakā rājya detā hū~ to bhī śaktise sambandha rakhanevālī isa kathāse kyā prayojana hai ? ||67|| yadi koī śakti jhelane ke lie sammukha huā aura prāṇoṃse rahita ho gayā to yaha kanyā aura svargakā rājya usakā kyā kara legā ? ||68|| saṃsārameṃ samasta vastuoṃse jīvana hī pyārā hai aura usīke lie anya saba prayatna hai yaha kauna nahīṃ jānatā hai ? ||69||
athānantara isa prakārake śabda sanakara lakṣmaṇane kotakavaśa kisī manuṣyase pūchā ki he bhadra ! yaha jitapadmā kauna hai ! jisake lie loga isa prakāra vārtā kara rahe haiṃ ||70|| isake uttarameṃ usa manuṣyane kahā ki jisakī kīrti samasta saṃsārameṃ vyāpta hai tathā jo apane āpako ati paṇḍita mānatī hai aisī isa kālakanyāko kyā tuma nahīṃ jānate ? |71|| yaha isa nagarake rājā śatrudamanako kanakābhā rānīse utpanna guṇavatī putrī hai ||72|| cūṃki isane mukhako kāntise kamalako 1. prasāda-kha. | 2. etannāmadheyāṃ kanyāṃ |

padmapurāṇe navayauvanasaṃpannā kalālaṃkāradhāriṇī | puṃso'pi tridaśān dveṣṭi manuṣyeṣu kathātra kā ||7|| uccārayati no śabdamapi pulliṅgavartinam | vyavahāraḥ samasto'syāḥ puruṣārthavivarjitaḥ ||75|| adaḥ paśyasi kailāsasadṛśaṃ mavana varam | atra tiṣṭhatyasau kanyā śatasevanalālitā||76|| śakti yaḥ pāṇinā muktāṃ pitrāsyāḥ sahate naraḥ | vṛṇute tamiyaṃ dagdha-samīhā kṛcchaśālinī ||77|| lakṣmīdharaḥ samākarṇya sakopasmayavismayaḥ | dadhyau sā kīdṛśī nāma kanyā yaivaṃ samīhate ||7|| duṣṭaceṣṭāmimāṃ tāvatkanyāṃ paśyāmi garvitām | aho punarabhiprāyaḥ prauḍho'yamanayā kṛtaḥ ||79|| | dhyāyanniti mahotī rājamārgaṇa cāruṇā | vimānāmān mahāśabdān prāsādānvidhupāṇḍurān ||8|| dantino jaladākārāṃsturaṃgāṃścalacāmarān | balamīnṛtyaśālāṃśca paśyan mantharacakṣuṣā ||1|| nānāni!hasaṃpannaṃ vicitradhvajaśomitam | śubhrābhrarāśisaṃkāśaṃ prāpa śabūṃdamālayam ||42|| māsvadbhaktiśatākīṇaṃ tuṅgaprākārayojitam | dvāraṃ tasya ḍuḍhauke'sau śakracāpāmatoraṇam ||8|| śastrivṛndāvṛte tasminnānopāyanasaṃkule | nirgacchadbhirviśaniśca sāmantairatisaṃkaṭe ||84|| dvāḥsthena praviśanneṣa babhāṣe saumyayā girā | kastvamajñāpito bhadra viśasi kṣitipālayam ||85|| so'vocavaṣṭumicchāmi rājānaṃ gaccha vedaya | svapade'nyamasau kṛtvā gatvā rājñe nyavedayat ||86|| didṛkṣustvāṃ mahārāja pumānindīvarapramaḥ | rājīvalocanaḥ śrīmān saumyo dvāre'vatiṣṭhate ||87||
athavā sarva śarīrase lakṣmīko jīta liyā hai isalie yaha jitapadā kahalātī hai ||73|| navayauvanase sampanna tathā kalārūpī alaṃkāroṃko dhāraṇa karanevālī yaha kanyā puṃvedadhārī devoṃse bhī dveṣa karatī hai phira manuṣyoṃkī to bāta hī kyā hai ? |74|| jo śabda vyākaraṇako dṛṣṭise puṃliṃga hotā hai yaha usakā bhī uccāraṇa nahīṃ karatī hai| isakā jitanā bhī vyavahāra hai vaha saba puruṣoṃke prayojanase rahita hai ||75|| sāmane jo kailāsa parvatake samāna baḍa़ā bhavana dekha rahe ho usīmeṃ yaha saikaḍa़oṃ prakārakī sevāoṃse lālita hotī huī rahatī hai ||76|| jo manuṣya isake pitāke hāthase choḍa़ī huī śaktiko sahana karegā use hī yaha varegī aisī kaṭhina pratijñā isane le rakhī hai ||77||
yaha sunakara lakṣmaṇa krodha, garva aura āścaryase yukta ho vicāra karane lage ki vaha kanyā kaisī hogī jo isa prakārakī ceṣṭā karatī hai ||78|| duṣṭa ceṣṭāse yukta tathā garvase bharī isa kanyāko dekhū to sahī| aho! isane yaha baḍa़ā kaṭhora abhiprāya kara rakhā hai ||79|| isa prakāra vicāra karate hue lakṣmaṇa mahāvṛṣabhakī nāī sundara cālase calakara manohara rājamārgameṃ āge baḍha़e| vahāṃ ve vimānake samāna ābhāvāle tathā candramāke samāna dhavala uttamottama bhavanoṃ, meghoṃke samāna hāthiyoṃ, caṃcala camaroṃse suśobhita ghoḍa़oṃ, chapariyoṃ aura nṛtyaśālāoṃko dhīmī dṛṣṭise dekhate jāte the ||80-81|| tadanantara jo nānā prakārake niyū~hoṃse yukta thā, raṃgabiraṃgī dhvajāoṃse suśobhita thā, tathā jo sapha़eda ghāvalīke samāna thā aise rājā śatraṃdamake mahalapara pahuṃce ||82|| mahalakā dvāra saikaḍa़oṃ dedīpyamāna belabūṭoṃse sahita thā, ū~ce prākārase yukta thā, aura indradhanuṣake samāna raṃga-biraṃge toraṇoṃse suśobhita thā ||83|| tadanantara jo śastradhārī paharedāroṃke samūhase āvṛta thā, nānā prakārake upahāroṃse yukta thā aura jahā~ bāhara nikalate tathā bhītara praveśa karate hue sāmantoṃkī baḍa़ī bhīḍa़ laga rahī thī aise dvārameṃ lakṣmaṇa praveśa karane lage to dvārapālane saumyavāṇīse kahā ki he bhadra ! tū kauna hai jo binā ājñā hī rājamahala meṃ praveśa kara rahā hai ||84-85|| taba lakṣmaṇane kahā ki maiṃ rājāke darśana karanā cāhatā hū~ so rājāko khabara de do| yaha suna apane sthānapara dūsareko niyukta kara dvārapālane bhītara jākara rājāse nivedana kiyā ki ||86|| he mahārāja ! jo āpake darśana karanā cāhatā hai, 1. mohokṣaṇa na. | mahokṣeti ma. amātyavadanaṃ vīkṣya rājāvocadviśatviāte | tataḥ sutaḥ sumitrāyāḥ pratīhārodito'viśat ||8|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā sundarākāraṃ sugambhīrāpi sā sabhā | samudramūrtivarakṣobhaṃ gatā śītāṃśudarśane ||89|| praṇāmarahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vikaṭāṃsaṃ subhāsuram | kiṃcidvikṛtacetaskastamapṛcchadariṃdamaḥ ||10|| kutaḥ samāgataḥ kastvaṃ kimartha kva kṛtaśramaḥ | tato lakṣmīdharo'vocat prāvṛṣeṇyadhanadhvaniḥ ||11|| bāyo'haṃ bharatasyāpi mahīhiṇḍanapaṇḍitaḥ | vidvān sarvatra te bhaṭakataṃ duhiturmānamāgataḥ ||12|| amagnamānaśṛṅgeyaṃ duṣṭakanyāgavī tvayā | poṣilā sarvalokasya vartate duḥkhadāyinī ||13|| so'vocad yo mayā muktāṃ śakaḥśakti pratīkṣitum | ko'sau nu jitapamāyā mānasya dhvaṃsako bhavet ||14|| uvāca lakṣmaṇaḥ śaktyā grahaṇaṃ me kimekayā | śaktīḥ pañca vimañca tvaṃ mayi śaktyā samastayā ||95|| vivādo garṣiṇorevaṃ pravṛtto yāvadetayoḥ| gavākṣā viniḍāstāvapihitā vanitānaḥ ||9|| parityakta naradveṣā dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇapuṅgavam | niyaṃhasthā jitāmsojā saṃjñādānādavārayat ||17|| dakṣabaddhāñjaliṃ bhīmaṃ saumitririti saṃjñayā | cakāra jātavodhā tāṃ mā bhaiṣīriti saṃnadī ||28|| jagāda ca kimadyāpi kātara tvaṃ pratīkṣase | visundhāriṃdamāmikhya śakti śakti nivedaya ||19|| ityuktaḥ kupito rājā baddhvā parikaraṃ dṛḍham | jvalatpāvakasaṃkāśāṃ dākkimekāmagādadau ||10|| pratīcchecchasi matu cedityuktvā bhṛkuṭīṃ dadhat | vaiśākha sthānakaṃ kṛtvā tāṃ mumoca vidhānavida ||10||
jisakī prabhā nīla kamalake samāna hai, jisake netra kamaloṃke samāna suśobhita haiṃ tathā jo atyanta saumya hai aisā eka śobhāsampanna puruṣa dvāra para khaḍa़ā hai ||87|| mantrīke mukhakī ora dekha rājāne kahā ki 'praveśa kare'| tadanantara dvārapālake kahane para lakṣmaṇane bhītara praveśa kiyā ||8|| yadyapi vaha sabhā gambhīra thī to bhī jisa prakāra candramāko dekhakara samudra kṣobhako prāpta hotā hai usī prakāra vaha sabhā bhī sundara ākārake dhāraka lakṣmaṇako dekhakara kṣobhako prāpta ho gayī ||8|| praṇāmarahita, viśāla kandhoṃke dhāraka tathā atiśaya dedīpyamāna lakṣmaṇako dekhakara jisakā hṛdaya kucha-kucha vikṛta ho rahā thā aise rājā śabūṃdamane pūchā ki tu kahāṃse āyā hai ? kauna hai ? aura kisa lie āyā hai ? isake uttarameṃ varṣā ṛtuke medhake samāna gambhīra dhvaniko dhāraṇa karanevāle lakṣmaṇane kahā ||90-91|| ki maiṃ rājā bharatakā sevaka hū~, pṛthvīpara ghūmane meṃ nipuṇa hū~, saba viṣayoṃkā paṇḍita hū~ aura tumhārī putrīkā māna bhaṅga karaneke lie āyā haiṃ |92|| jisake mānarūpī sīṃga abhagna haiṃ aisī jo duṣṭa kanyārūpī marakanī gāya tumane pāla rakkhī hai vaha saba logoṃko duḥkha denevālī hai ||93|| rājā śava॒damane kahā ki jo mere dvārā choḍa़ī huī śaktiko sahana karane meṃ samartha hai aisā vaha kauna puruṣa hai jo jitapadmākā māna khaṇḍita karane vālā ho ||94|| lakṣmaṇane kahā ki maiṃ eka śaktiko kyā grahaṇa karū~? tu pūrī sāmarthya ke sātha majhapara pā~ca śaktiyāṃ choḍa़ ||15|| yahāṃ jaba taka donoṃ ahaṃkāriyoṃke bīca isa prakārakā vivāda cala rahā thā vahā~ taba taka rājamahalake saghana jharokhe striyoṃke mukhoṃse ācchādita ho gaye !96|| jitapadmā bhī lakṣmaṇako dekha mohita ho gayī aura puruṣoṃke sātha dveṣako choḍa़kara chaparī para ā baiṭhī tathā iśārā dekara lakṣmaṇako manā karane lagī ||97|| taba harṣase bhare lakṣmaṇane bhayabhīta tathā hātha joḍa़kara baiṭhī huī jitapadmāko iśārā dekara jatāyā ki bhaya mata karo ||98|| aura rājāse kahā ki are kātara! aba bhī kyā pratīkṣā kara rahā hai ? śaśṛṃdama nāma rakhe phiratā hai śakti choḍa़ aura parākrama dikhā ||99|| isa prakāra kahane para rājāne kupita ho acchī taraha kamara kasī aura jalatī huī agnike samāna eka śakti uṭhāyī ||100|| tadanantara 'yadi maranā hī cāhatā hai to le jhela' yaha kahakara bhauṃhako dhāraṇa karanevāle vidhi-vidhānake jñātā rājāne ālīḍha़ āsanase khaḍa़ā hokara vaha gadā 1. na. ma., ja. | 2. śaktināmakaśastram | 3. parākramam | 4. pratīkṣecchasi ma.|

174
padmapurāṇe
'ayatneneva sā tena dhṛtā dakṣiṇapāṇinā | vartikāgrahaṇe ko vā bahumāno garutmataḥ ||102|| dvitīyetarahastena kakṣābhyāṃ ve suvibhramaḥ | śuśubhe subhṛśaṃ tāmiścaturdanta iva dvipaḥ ||103|| saṃkruddhamogimogomāṃ saṃprāptāmatha pañcamīm | dantāgrābhyāṃ dadhau śakti peśīmiva mṛgādhipaḥ ||104|| tato devagaṇāḥ svasthā vavṛṣaḥ puṣpasaṃhatim | nanatastāḍayāṃścakrardandamīśca tasvanāḥ||105|| pratīcchāriṃdamedānī śakti tvamiti lakṣmaṇe | kṛtaśabde paraṃ prāpa sādhvasaṃ sakalā janaḥ ||106|| tamakṣatatanaṃ dṛṣṭā lakṣmīnilayavakṣasam | vismito'riṃdamo jātastrapāvanamitānanaḥ ||10|| jitapadmā tata: prāpa smitacchāyānatānanā | lakṣmīdharaṃ samākṛṣṭā rūpeṇācaritena ca ||108|| dhṛtaśaktaḥ samīpe'sya sā tanvī śuśubhetarām | kuliśāyudhapāvasthā śacīvaṃ vinatānanā ||10|| navena saṃgamenāsyā hṛdayaṃ tasya kampitam | yamāsīt kampitaṃ jātu saṃgrāmeṣu mahatsvapi ||110|| purastātanareśānāṃ kanyayā lakṣmaṇā vṛtaḥ | vibhidyāpanapāpālī tadbharanyastanetrayā ||11|| sadyo vinayanamrāṅgo rājānaṃ lakṣmaṇo'bravīt | māmakāhasi me kṣantuṃ śaiśavādurviceṣṭitam ||112|| bālānāṃ pratikūlena karmaṇā vacasāpi vā | bhavadvidhā sugambhīrā naiva yānti vikāritām ||113|| tataḥ śatraṃdamo'pyenaṃ sapramodaḥ sasaṃbhramaḥ | stambaramakarāmābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ pariṣaṣvaje ||114|| uvāca ca pariklinnagaṇḍāṃścaṇḍān gajān kṣaṇāt | yo'jaiṣaṃ bhīmayuddheṣu bhadra so'haṃ svayā jitaḥ ||115||
choḍa़ dī ||101|| lakṣmaṇane binā kisī yatnake hī dāhine hāthase vaha śakti pakaḍa़ lī so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki baṭerake pakaḍa़ne meṃ garuḍakā kauna-sā baḍa़ā māna hotā hai ? ||102|| dūsarī śakti dūsare hāthase tathā tīsarī cauthī śakti donoṃ bagaloṃmeṃ dhāraṇa kara pulakate hue lakṣmaṇa unase cāra dā~toṃko dhāraṇa karanevāle airāvata hāthīke samāna atyadhika suśobhita ho rahe the ||103|| athānantara atyanta kupita sāṃpakī phaṇakī nāī jo pā~cavīṃ śakti āyī use lakṣmaṇane dā~toṃke agrabhāgase usa prakāra pakaḍa़ liyā jisa prakāra ki mṛgarāja māṃsakī ḍalīko pakaḍa़ rakhatā hai||104|| tadanantara ākāśameṃ khaḍa़e devoṃke samūha puṣpa barasāne lage, nṛtya karane lage tathā harṣase śabda karate hue dundubhi bāje banāne lage ||105||
athānantara 'śabūṃdama ! aba tū merī śakti jhela' isa prakāra lakṣmaṇake kahanepara sabaloga atyanta bhayako prāpta hue ||106|| rājā śatrundama lakṣmaṇako akṣata śarīra dekha vismayameṃ paḍa़ gayā aura lajjāse usakā mukha nīcā ho gayā ||107|| tadanantara manda musakānakī chāyāse jisakā makha nīcekī ora ho rahā thā aisā jitapadmā rūpa tathā ācaraṇase khicakara lakṣmaṇake pāsa āyī ||108|| śaktiyoṃko dhāraṇa karanevāle lakṣmaṇake pāsa vaha kṛśāṅgī, isa taraha atyanta suśobhita ho rahī thī jisa taraha ki vajrake dhāraka indrake pāsa khaḍa़ī natamukhī indrāṇī suśobhita hotī hai ||109|| lakṣmaṇakā jo hṛdaya baḍa़e-baḍa़e saṃgrāmoṃmeṃ bhī kabhī kampita nahīṃ huā thā vaha jitapadmāke nūtana samāgamase kampita ho gayā ||110|| tadanantara lajjāke bhārase jisake netra nīce ho rahe the aisī jitapadmāne pitā tathā anya aneka rājāoṃke sāmane lajjā choḍa़kara lakṣmaṇakā varaṇa kiyā ||111|| tatkāla hī vinayase jisakā śarīra namrībhūta ho rahā thā aise lakṣmaṇane rājāse kahā ki he māma ! laḍa़kapanake kāraṇa maiṃne jo khoṭī ceṣṭā kī hai use āpa kṣamā karaneke yogya haiṃ ||112|| bālakoṃke viparīta kārya athavā viruddha vacanoṃse āpa jaise mahāgambhīra puruṣa vikāra bhāvako prāpta nahīṃ hote ||113||
tadanantara harṣa aura saṃbhramase sahita rājā śadamane bhī hāthokī saṃḍake samāna lambī tathā supuṣṭa bhujāoṃse lakṣmaṇakā āliṃgana kiyā ||114|| aura kahā ki he bhadra ! jisa maiṃne 1. ayanenaiva ma. | 2. bhogānāṃ ma.| 3. pratīkṣā ma.| 4. śacī vinamitānanā ma. |

aṣṭatriṃśattamaṃ parva
175 vanyānapi mahānāgān gaṇḍaśailasamatviṣaḥ | vimadīkṛtavānasmi so'yamanya ivāmavam ||116|| aho vīryamaho rūpaṃ sadṛśāḥ śuma te guṇāḥ | ahonuddhatatātyantaṃ praśyaśca tavādbhutaḥ ||117|| bhāṣamāṇe guṇānevaṃ rājñi saṃsadyavasthite | lakṣmīdharastrapāto'bhūt kvāpi yāta iva kṣaṇam ||118|| atha labdhāmbudavātaghoṣabheryaḥ samāhatāḥ | rājādeśāt samādhmātāḥ śaṅkhāḥ saṃśitavāraṇāḥ ||119|| yatheṣṭaṃ dīyamāneṣu dhaneṣu paramastataḥ | ānando'vartatāśeṣanagarakṣomadakṣiṇaḥ ||120|| tato lakṣmīdharo'vāci rājñā puruṣapuṅgava | tvayā duhituricchāmi pāṇigrahaṇamīkṣitum ||121|| so'vocannagarasyāsya pradeśe nikaṭe mama | jyeṣṭastiṣṭhati taṃ pṛccha sa jānāti yathocitam ||122|| tataḥ syandanamāropya jitapadmā salakṣmaṇām | sadārabandhurabhyāśaṃ pratasthe tasya sādaraḥ ||123|| tataḥ kṣubdhāpagānāthanirghoṣapratimadhvanim | śrutvā vokṣya viśālaṃ ca dhūlīpaṭalamudgatam ||12|| jānunyastamuhuḥsastakarā kṛcchātsamutthitā| sītā jagāda saṃbhrātā girā praskhalitā bhuhuḥ ||125|| kṛtaṃ saumitriṇā nūnaṃ rāghavoddhataceṣṭitam | āśeyamākulātyantaṃ dṛśyate kṛtyamāśrayaḥ ||126|| āśliṣya jānakī devi mā bhaiṣīriti śabdayan | uttasthau rādhavaḥ kṣipraṃ dṛṣṭiṃ dhanuṣi pātayan ||127|| tāvacca naravṛndasya mahataḥ sthitamagrataḥ | sutāragītanisvānamīkṣāṃcakre'ṅganājanam ||128|| krameṇa gacchataścāsya pratyāsattiṃ manoharāḥ vibhramāḥ samadṛśyanta sudārāvayavosthitāḥ ||129|| nṛtyantaṃ ca samālokya tāranūpuraśiñjitam | viśrabdhaḥ sītayā sākaṃ padmaḥ punarūpāviśat ||130||
bhayaṃkara yuddhoṃmeṃ madasrāvī kupita hāthiyoṃko kṣaṇabharameṃ jītā thā vaha maiṃ āja tumhāre dvārā jītā gayā ||115|| jisane gola kālī caṭṭānovāle parvatake samāna kāntike dhāraka baḍa़e-baḍa़e jaṃgalī hāthiyoṃko madarahita kiyā thā vaha maiṃ āja māno anya hī ho gayā hū~||116|| dhanya tumhārī anuddhatatā aura dhanya tumhārī adbhuta vinaya| aho śobhanīka ! tumhāre guṇa tumhāre anurūpa hī haiṃ ||117|| isa prakāra sabhāmeṃ baiṭhā rājā śadama jaba lakṣmaṇake guṇoṃkā varṇana kara rahā thā taba lakṣmaṇa lajjāke kāraṇa aise ho gaye māno kṣaṇabharake lie kahīṃ cale hī gaye hoṃ ||118||
athānantara rājākī ājñāse meghasamūhako garjanāke samāna viśāla śabda karanevālī bheriyāṃ bajāyī gayīṃ aura hāthiyoṃkī ciṃghāḍa़kā saṃśaya utpanna karanevāle śaṃkha phūṃke gaye ||119|| icchānusāra dhana diyā jāne lagā aura samasta nagarako kṣobhita karanemeṃ samartha bahuta bhārī ānanda pravṛtta huā ||120|| tadanantara rājāne lakṣmaṇase kahā ki he śreṣṭha puruṣa ! maiṃ tumhāre sātha putrīkā pāṇigrahaṇa dekhanā cāhatā hū~ ||121|| isake uttarameṃ lakṣmaṇane kahā ki isa nagarake nikaṭavartī pradeśameṃ mere baḍa़e bhāī virājamāna haiṃ so unase pūcho vahī ṭhīka jānate haiṃ ||122|| ta sahita jitapadmāko ratha para baiṭhākara striyoṃ tathā bhāī-bandhuoṃse sahita rājā śa@dama baḍa़e ādarake sātha rāmake samīpa calā ||123|| tadanantara kṣobhako prāpta hue samudrako garjanāke samāna joradāra śabda sunakara aura uṭhe hue viśāla dhulipaṭalako dekhakara ghuṭanopara bāra-bāra hātha rakhatī huī sītā baḍe kaṣṭase uṭhī aura ghabaḍākara skhalita vāṇīmeṃ rāmase bolī ki he rāghava ! jāna paḍatā hai lakṣmaṇane koī uddhata ceṣṭā kī hai| yaha diśā atyanta ākula dikhāī detī hai isalie sāvadhāna hoo aura jo kucha karanā ho so karo ||124-126|| taba sītākā āliṃgana kara 'he devi ! bhayabhīta mata hoo' yaha kahate tathā śīghra hī dhanuṣapara dṛṣṭi ḍālate hue rāma uṭhe ||127|| itanemeṃ hī unhoṃne viśāla nara-samūhake āge uccasvarase maṃgala gīta gānevālī striyoṃkā samūha dekhā ||128|| vaha striyoṃkā samūha jaba krama-kramase pāsa āyā taba sundara striyoṃke śarīrase utpanna honevāle manohara hāva-bhāva dikhāī diye ||129|| tadanantara jinake nūpuroṃkī joradāra jhanakāra
1. śaṃsita ma.

padmapurāṇe
striyo maṅgalahastāstaṃ savālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ | buḍhokire'tihāriṇyaḥ samadasphītalocanāḥ ||131|| rathādutīrya padmāsyaḥ sahito jitapadmayā | patiḥ papāta padmāyāḥ padmasya caraṇau drutam ||132|| padmasya prati kṛtvā sītāyā api satrapaḥ | niviśya nātinikaṭe padmasya vinayī sthitaḥ || 133 || nṛpāḥ śatrudamādyāśca kramātkṛtvā namaskṛtim | padmasya sahasītasya yathāsthānamavasthitāḥ ||134|| tatra saṃkathayā sthitvā kuśalapraśnapūrvayā | kṛte ca punarānandanartane pārthivairapi ||135|| ṛdayā paramayā yuktaḥ sasītī lakṣmaṇī balaḥ | praviṣṭaḥ syandanārūḍo nagaraṃ pramadānvitaḥ || 136 || tatra lāvaṇyakiñjalkayoṣitkuvalayākule | mahāprāsādasarasi svanadbhūṣaṇapakṣiṇi ||137|| narebhakalamau satyavratasiṃhadhvaneralam | vāsān saṃkucitasvāntī kumāraśrīsamanvitau ||138|| śatrudamakṛtacchandau kiṃcitkālaṃ mahāsukha | uṣitau sarvalokasya cittāhlādanadāyinī || 139 || jitapadma tato bhātāṃ virahādatiduḥkhitām | parisāntvya priyairvākyairvanamālāmivādarāt || 140 | padmaḥ sītānugo bhūtvā niśīthe svairanirgataḥ | yāto lakṣmīdharo datvā paurāṇāmadhṛtiṃ parām ||341|| śārdūlavikrīḍitam
ye janmāntarasaṃcitādisukṛtāḥ sarvāsumājāṃ priyāḥ
yaṃ yaṃ deśamupavrajanti vividhaṃ kṛtyaṃ bhajantaḥ param | tasminsarvahṛ pīkasaukhyacaturasteṣāṃ vinā cintayā mṛṣṭānnādividhirbhavatyanupamo yo triṣṭape durlabhaḥ || 142 ||
phaila rahī thī aisī striyoṃke samūhako nṛtya karatā dekha rāma niścinta ho sītā ke sātha punaḥ baiṭha gaye || 130 ||
athānantara jinake hāthoṃmeṃ maṃgala dravya the, jo saba prakārake alaṃkāroṃse alaṃkṛta thīṃ, atiśaya manohara thīṃ aura jinake netra madase phūla rahe the aisī striyā~ rāmake pāsa āyīṃ ||131|| kamalake samāna mukhako dhāraṇa karanevāle lakṣmaṇa jitapadmā ke sātha rathase utarakara śīghra hī rāmake caraṇoṃmeṃ jā paḍa़e ||132|| tadanantara rāma aura sītāko praṇāma kara lajāte hue lakṣmaṇa rāmase kucha dūra haṭakara vinayapūrvaka baiṭha gaye ||133 || śatrundama ādi rājā bhī krama kramase rāma tathā sītāko namaskāra kara yathā sthāna baiṭha gaye || 134|| kuśala samācāra pūchakara saba vārtālāpa karate hue sukhase baiṭhe tathā rājāoṃne ānanda-nṛtya kiyā || 135 || tadanantara parama sampadā se yukta tathā harṣase bhare rāma lakṣmaṇa aura sītāne rathapara savāra ho nagarameṃ praveśa kiyā || 136 || vahā~ rājamahala meṃ pahu~ce | vaha rājamahala eka sarovarake samāna jāna paḍa़tā thā kyoṃki saundaryaṃ rūpī keśarase yukta striyoṃ rūpī nīla kamaloṃse vaha vyāpta thā aura śabda karate hue ābhūṣaṇa rūpī pakṣiyoṃse yukta thā || 137 || satyavrata rūpī siṃhakī garjanāke bhayase jinake citta atyanta saṃkucita rahate the, jo kumāra lakṣmī sahita the, rājā śatrundama jinako icchānusāra saba sevā karatā thā, jo mahā sukhase sahita the tathā jo samasta logoṃ ke cittako ānanda denevāle the aise nara śreṣṭha rāma lakṣmaṇa usa rājamahala meṃ kucha samaya taka sukhase rahe ||138 - 139||
tadanantara rāma ardharātrike samaya sītāke sātha icchānusāra rājamahala se bāhara nikala paḍa़e aura lakṣmaṇa bhī vanamālā ke samāna virahase bhayabhīta atiśaya duḥkhī jitapadmāko priya vacanoṃ dvārā ādara pūrvaka sāntvanā de rāmake sātha cale| ina sabake jānese nagaravāsiyoṃkā dhairyaṃ jātā rahā ||140-141 || gotamasvāmī kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! jinhoṃne janmāntarameṃ bahuta
1. padmāyāḥ patiḥ = lakṣmaṇaḥ | 2. chitvā ma | 3. nikhilaprāṇinām |

atha nānādumakṣmāsu bahupuṣpasugandhiṣu | latāmaṇḍapayuktāsu sevitāsa sukhaṃ mṛgaiḥ ||1|| devopanītaniśśeṣaśarīrasthitisādhanau | āyāta ramamāṇau tau sasītau rāmalakṣmaṇau ||2|| kvacidvidrumasaṃkāśaṃ rāmaḥ kisalayaṃ laghu | gṛhītvā kurute karṇa jānakyāḥ sādhviti bruvan ||3|| sutarauṃ 'saṃgatāṃ vallīṃ kvacidāropya jānakīm | svairaṃ dolayataḥ pārśvavartinau rāmalakṣmaṇau ||4|| drumakhaṇḍe kvacid sthitvā nitāntaghanapallave | kathābhiḥ suvidagdhāmiḥ kurutastadvinodanam ||5|| iyametadayaṃ vallī palāśaṃ tarurīkṣyatām | hāriṇī hāri hārīti sītoce rāghavaṃ kvacit ||6|| kvacid bhramarasaṃghātaimukhasaurabhalolupaiḥ | kṛcchādarakṣatāmetau rājaputrī kadarthitām ||7|| śanairviharamāṇo tau sasītau śubhavibhramau | kānaneṣu vicitreṣu svarvaneṣu surāviva ||8|| nānājanopabhogyeṣu deśeṣu nihitekṣaṇau| dhīrau krameṇa saṃprāptau puraṃ vaṃśasthaladyutim ||9|| sudīrgho'pi tayoḥ kālo gacchatoḥ sahasītayoḥ | puṇyānugatayo sīdapi duḥkhalavapradaḥ ||10|| apaśyatāṃ ca tasyānte vaṃśajālātisaṃkaṭam | nagaṃ vaṃśadharābhikhyaṃ mittveva bhuvamudagatam ||11|| chāyayā tuṅgaśṛṅgāṇāṃ yaḥ sandhyāmiva saṃtatam | dadhāti nirjharāṇāṃ ca hasatīva ca śīkaraiḥ ||12|| nirgacchantī prajāṃ dṛṣṭvā purādatha sa ekakām | rāmaḥ papraccha bhoḥ kasmāt trāso'yaṃ sumahāniti ||13||
athānantara jinakī śarīra-sthitike samasta sādhana devopanīta the, aise sītā sahita rāmalakṣmaṇa ramaṇa karate hue vanako una bhūmiyoṃmeṃ āye jo nānā prakārake vṛkṣoṃse sahita thī, jinameṃ nānā phaloṃkī sugandhi phaila rahī thī, jo latāmaṇḍapoṃse sahita thī tathā magagaṇa jinameṃ sakhase nivāsa karate the ||1-2|| kahīṃ rāma, mūṃgake samāna kāntivāle pallavako toḍa़kara tathā usakā karṇābharaṇa banākara 'yaha ṭhīka rahegā' isa prakāra kahate hue sītāke kānameṃ pahināte the, to kahīṃ kisī vṛkṣa para laṭakatī latā para sītāko baiṭhākara bagalameṃ donoṃ ora khaḍa़e ho rāma-lakṣmaṇa use jhūlā jhulāte the ||3-4|| kahīṃ saghana pattoṃvāle druma-khaṇḍameṃ baiṭhakara manohara-manohara kathāoṃse usakā manovinoda karate the ||5|| kahīṃ sītā rāmase kahatī thī ki yaha manohara latā dekho, kahīṃ kahatī thī ki yaha manohara pallava dekho aura kahīṃ kahatī thī ki yaha manohara vṛkṣa dekho ||6|| kahīṃ mukhakī sugandhike lobhī bhramaroṃke samūha sītāko pīḍa़ita karate the, so ye donoṃ bhāī baḍa़ī kaṭhināīse usakī rakṣā karate the ||7|| jisa prakāra deva svargake vanoṃmeṃ vihāra karate haiṃ usī prakāra śubha ceṣṭāoṃke dhāraka donoṃ bhāī sītāko sātha liye nānā prakārake vanoṃmeṃ dhīre-dhīre vihāra karate the ||8|| nānā manuṣyoṃse upabhogya deśoṃmeṃ dṛṣṭi ḍālate hue ve dhīra-vīra kramase vaṃśasthāti nāmaka nagarameṃ pahu~ce ||9|| sītāke sātha bhramaṇa karate hue una puṇyānugāmī mahāpuruṣoṃko yadyapi bahuta kāla ho gayā thā to bhī utanā baḍa़ā kāla unheṃ aṃśamātra bhī duḥkha denevālā nahīṃ huā thā ||10||
__usa nagarake samīpa hī unhoṃne vaṃśadhara nāmakā parvata dekhā jo bāṃsoṃke samūhase atyanta vyāpta thā, pṛthivīko bhedakara hī māno ūpara uṭhā thā, ū~ce-ūṃce śikharoṃko kāntise jo māno sadā sandhyāko dhāraṇa kara rahā thā aura nirjharanoṃke chīṃṭoṃse aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno haṃsa hī rahā ho ||11-12| unhoṃne yaha bhī dekhā ki prajāke loga nagarase nikala-nikala kara kahīṃ anyatra 1. saṃstutām ba. | 2. iyaṃ hāriṇī vallī, etat hāri palāśaṃ, ayaṃ hārī taruḥ | 3. svavaneṣu ma. | 4. dhāro ma.|

so'vocadadya divasastṛtīyo vartate naraḥ | naktamuttiṣṭhato'muṣminnage nādasya' mastake ||14|| dhvaniraśrutapūrvo'yaṃ pratinādī bhayāvahaḥ | kasyeti bahuvijñānairna vṛddharapi vedyate ||15|| saṃkṣubhyatīva bhūḥ sarvā nandantīva diśo daśa | sarāṃsi saṃcarantīva nirmūlyanta ivājripāḥ ||16|| rauravārāvaraudreṇa ghanena dhvanināmunā | śravaṇau sarvalokasya tāḍya te'yodhanairiva ||17|| niśāgame kimasmākaṃ vadhārthamayamudyataḥ | karoti krīḍanaṃ tāvat ko'pi viṣṭapakaṇṭakaḥ ||18|| bhayena svanatastasmādayaṃ loko niśāgame | palāyate prabhāte tu punareti yathāyatham ||19|| sāgraṃ yojanametasmādatītyānyonyabhāṣitam | śṛṇotyayaṃ janaḥ kiṃcit prāpnoti ca sukhāsikām ||20|| niśamyoktamidaṃ sītā babhāṣe rāmalakṣmaṇau | vathamanyatra gacchāmo yatra yāti mahājanaḥ ||21|| kālaṃ deśaṃ ca vijñāya nātiśāstraviśāradaiḥ | kriyate pauruṣaṃ tena na jātu vipadāpyate ||22|| prahasyāvocatāmetāmudvignā janakātmajām | gaccha svaṃ yatra loko'yaṃ vrajatyalaghusādhvase ||23|| anviṣyantī prabhāte nau lokena sahitāmunā | amuṣmin gaṇḍaśailānte gatamīrāgamiṣyati ||24|| asmin mahīdhare ramye dhvaniratyantamīṣaṇaḥ | kasyāyamiti paśyāmo vayamadyeti niścayaḥ ||25|| prabhīṣyate varāko'yaṃ lokaḥ śiśusamākulaḥ | paśubhiḥ sahitaḥ svantamasya ko nu kariṣyati ||26|| vaidehī sajvarevoce satataṃ bhavatorimam | hatuṃ me grahaṃ śaktaḥ kaḥ kulīragrahopamam ||27||
jā rahe haiṃ| taba rāmane kisī eka manuṣyase pūchā ki he bhadra! yaha bahuta bhārī bhaya kisa kāraṇase hai ? ||13|| isake uttarameṃ usa manuṣyane kahā ki isa parvatake śikhara para rātrike samaya śabda uṭhate hue āja tīsarā dina hai ||14|| jo śabda parvata para hotā hai vaha hamane pahale kabhī nahīṃ sunā, usakī pratidhvani sarvatra gūṃja uṭhatī hai tathā vaha atyanta bhayaṃkara hai| kisa vyaktikā śabda hai ? yaha bahuvijñānī vṛddha loga bhī nahīṃ jānate haiṃ ||15|| isa śabdase māno samasta pṛthivī hila uṭhatī hai, daśoṃ diśāe~ māno śabda karane lagatī haiṃ, sarovara māno idhara-udhara phirane lagate haiṃ aura vṛkṣa māno ukhaḍa़ne lagate haiṃ ||16|| raudratāmeṃ narakake śabdakī tulanā karanevāle isa bhārī śabdase samasta logoṃke kāna aise phaṭe paḍa़te haiṃ māno loheke ghanoṃse hī tāḍita hote hoṃ ||17|| jāna paḍa़tā hai ki rātrike samaya hama logoṃkā vadha karaneke lie udyata huā yaha koī lokakā kaṇṭaka krīḍa़ā karatā phiratā hai ||18| ye loga usa śabdake bhayase rātri prārambha hote hī bhāga jāte haiṃ aura prabhāta hone para punaḥ vāpisa ā jāte haiṃ ||19|| yahā~se kucha adhika eka yojana calakara yaha śabda itanā halakā ho jātā hai ki loga parasparakā vārtālāpa suna sakate haiṃ tathā kucha ārāma prāpta kara sakate haiṃ' ||20||

__athānantara unhoṃne ūpara jākara aise do muni dekhe jo uttamadhyānameṃ ārūḍha the, jinakī lambī bhujāe~ nīcekī ora laṭaka rahī thīṃ, jo atyanta duḥsādhya caturmukhī pratimāko siddha kara rahe the, parama tejase yukta the, samudra ke samāna gambhīra the. parvatake samāna sthira the, śarīra aura ātmākī bhinnatāko jānanevāle the, mohase rahita the, digambara-mudrāko dhāraṇa karanevāle the, kāntike sāgara the, nūtana tāruṇyase yukta the, uttama ākārake dhāraka the aura āgamokta ācaraṇa karanevāle the ||33-35|| āścaryako prāpta hue ve tīnoṃ aśubha karmoṃke āśrayakā parityāga kara isa prakāra vicāra karane lage ki saṃsārameṃ prāṇiyoṃkī samasta ceṣṭāe~ niḥsāra tathā duḥkhake kāraṇa haiṃ ||36|| mitra, dhana, strī, putra, aura bhāī-bandhu ādi sabhī sukha-duḥkha rūpa haiṃ, eka dharma hī sukhakā kāraṇa hai ||37|| tadanantara jo bhaktise yukta the, jinhoṃne hātha joḍa़kara mastaka para lagā rakkhe the, jo parama santoṣako dhāraṇa kara rahe the, aura vinayase jinake śarīra namrībhūta ho rahe the, aise ve tīnoṃ ukta munirājoṃke pāsa gaye ||38|| darśana karate hī unhoṃne, jo atyanta bhayaṃkara the, idhara-udhara cala rahe the, vikaṭa śabda kara rahe the, masale hue aṃjanake samāna kāntivāle the, tathā jinakī jībheṃ lapalapā rahī thīṃ aise sā~poṃse aura jinhoṃne apanī pūṃcha ūpara uṭhā rakkhī thī, jo atyanta bhayaṃkara the, rāta-dina eka-dūsarese saṭakara cala rahe the, nānā raṃgake the, evaṃ bahuta moṭe the, aise bicchuoṃse 1, vistīrya ma. | 2. sarve'pi ka. | 3. sarpaḥ | 4. veṣṭitairvṛścikaiśca ma. |

181 tathāvidhau ca tau dṛṣṭvā rāmo'pi sahalakṣmaṇaḥ | sahasā trāsamāyātau bheje stambhamiva kṣaṇam ||41|| vaidehī bhayasaṃpannā bhartāraṃ pariṣasvaje | mā bhaiṣīriti tāmūce mayaṃ tyaktvā kṣaṇena saḥ ||42|| upasṛtya tataḥ svairaṃ tābhyāṃ pannagavṛścikāḥ | atyastā kārmukāgreṇa muhuḥ kṛtavivartanāḥ ||43|| athodvartya ciraṃ pādau tayornirjharavāriṇā | gandhena sītayā lipto cāruṇā purumāvayā ||44|| āsannānāṃ ca vallīnāṃ kusumairvanasaurabhaiḥ | lakṣmīdharārpitaiḥ śuklaiḥ pūritāntaramarcitau ||45|| tataste karayugmābjamukulabhājitālikāḥ | cakruyogīśvarī bhaktyā vandanāṃ vidhikovidāḥ ||46|| vīṇāṃ ca saṃnidhāyāṅke vadhūmiva manoharām | padmo'vādayadatyuddhaṃ gāyan sumadhurākṣaram ||47|| anvagāyadimaṃ lakṣmīlatāliṅgitapādapaḥ | vāko kilaravaḥ putraḥ kaikayyāstattvemādaram ||48|| mahāyogeśvarā dhīrā manasā śirasā girā | vandhāste sādhavo nityaṃ surairapi suceṣṭitāḥ ||49|| upamānavinirmuktaṃ yairavyāhatamuttamam | prāptaṃ tribhuvanakhyātaṃ subhāgthairaha dakṣaram ||50|| minnaṃ yaiānadaṇḍena mahāmohaśilātalam | dīnaṃ vidanti ye viśvaṃ dharmānuṣṭhānavarjitam ||5|| gāyatorakṣarāṇyevaṃ tayorgānarvidhijñayoḥ | tiraścāmapi cetāṃsi pariprāptāni mārdavam ||52|| tato viditaniśśeṣacārunartanalakṣaṇā | manojñākalpasaṃpannā hāramālyādibhūṣitā ||53|| līlayā parayā yuktā darśitābhinayā sphuṭam | cārubāhulatāmārā hāvabhāvādikovidā ||54||
una donoṃ muniyoṃko ghirā dekhā ||39-40|| ukta prakārake muniyoṃko dekha, rāma bhī lakṣmaṇake sātha sahasā bhayako prāpta hue tathā kṣaṇa bharake lie niścala raha gaye ||41|| sītā bhayabhīta ho patise lipaṭa gayī, taba rāmane kṣaṇa ekameṃ bhaya choḍa़kara sītāse kahā ki ḍaro mata ||42|| tadanantara rāma-lakṣmaṇane dhīre-dhīre pāsa jākara jo dūra haṭānepara bhī bāra-bāra vahīṃ lauṭakara āte the aise sāṃpa, bicchuoṃko dhanuṣake agrabhāgase dūra kiyā ||43||
___ athānantara bhaktise bharī sītāne nirjharake jalase dera taka una muniyoṃke paira dhokara manohara gandhase lipta kiye ||44|| tathā jo vanako sugandhita kara rahe the evaṃ lakṣmaṇane jo toḍa़kara diye the, aise nikaṭavartī latāoṃke phūloṃse unakī khūba pūjā kī ||45|| tadanantara aṃjalirūpī kamalako boḍa़iyoṃse jinake lalāṭa śobhāyamāna the tathā jo vidhi-vidhānake jānane meṃ nipuṇa the aise una sabane bhaktipūrvaka munirājako vandanā kī ||46|| atyanta uttama tathā madhura akṣaroṃmeṃ gāte hue rāmane manohara strīke samāna vīṇāko godameṃ rakhakara bajāyā ||47|| inake sātha hī lakṣmaṇane bhī baḍa़e ādarase tattvapūrṇa gāna gāyā| usa samaya lakṣmaṇa, lakṣmīrūpī latāse āliṃgita vṛkṣake samāna jāna paḍa़te the aura unakā madhura śabda koyalako mīṭhī tānake samāna mālūma hotā thā ||48|| ve gā rahe the ki jo mahāyogake svāmī haiṃ, dhīra-vīra haiṃ tathā uttama ceṣṭāoṃse sahita haiṃ, uttama bhāgyake dhāraka jina muniyoṃne upamāse rahita, akhaṇḍita, tathā tīna lokameṃ prasiddha 'arhat' yaha uttama akṣara prāpta kara liyā haiṃ | jinhoṃne dhyānarūpī daṇḍake dvārā mahāmoharūpī śilātalako toḍa़ diyā hai aura jo dharmānuṣṭhāna-dharmācaraṇase rahita viśvako dona samajhate haiṃ aise sādhu devoṃke dvārā bhī manase, śirase tathā vacanase vandanīya haiṃ ||49-51|| mānakī vidhiko jānanevāle rāma-lakṣmaṇa java isa prakārake akṣara gā rahe the taba tiryaṃcoṃke bhī citta komalatāko prāpta ho gaye the ||52||
tadanantara jo samasta sundara nṛtyoṃke lakṣaṇa jānatī tho, manohara beṣabhūṣāse yukta thī, hāra mālā ādise alaṃkṛta thī, parama līlāse sahita thī, spaṣṭarūpase abhinaya dikhalā rahī thī, jisakī bāhurūpī latāoṃkā bhāra atyanta sundara thā, jo hāva-bhāva ādike dikhalānemeṃ nipuṇa thī, laya badalaneke samaya jisake sundara stanoṃkā maṇḍala kucha ūpara uṭhakara kampita ho rahā thā, jisake 1. bhrājitalalāṭāḥ | 2. -mācaran ma.|

183 viceṣṭitamidaṃ vyartha nājñāsiṣṭāṃ mahāmunī | tayohi 'jñānakarmāntaśukladhyānamayaṃ tadā ||6|| tathāvidhaṃ tamālokya vṛttāntaṃ varabhītidam | saṃhṛtya jānakī nṛtyamāśliṣyatkampinī patim ||69|| padmo jagāda tāṃ devi mā bhaiṣīḥ śubhamānase | upaguhya muneḥ pādau tiṣṭha sarvabhayacchidau ||70|| ityuktvā pādayoḥ kāntāṃ munerāsādya lāgalī | lakṣmīdharakumāreṇa sākaṃ sannāhamāśritaḥ ||71|| sajalāviva jīmūtau garjitau tau mahāpramau | nirghātamiva muñcantau samāsphālayatāṃ dhanuḥ ||72|| tatastau saṃbhramī jñātvā rāmanārāyaṇāviti | suro vahniprabhāmikhyastirodhānamupeyivān ||73|| jyotirvare gate tasmin samastaṃ tadviceṣṭitam | sapadi pralayaṃ yātaṃ jātaṃ ca vimalaṃ nabhaḥ ||74|| prātihārye kṛte tābhyāmicchadbhyāṃ paramaṃ hitam | utpannaṃ kevalajñānaṃ munipuṅgavayoḥ kṣaṇāt ||75|| caturvidhāstato devā nānāyānasamāśritāḥ | samājagmuḥ praśaṃsanto muditāstapasaḥ phalam ||76|| preṇamya vidhinā tatra kṛtvā kevalapūjanam | racitāñjalayo devā yathāsthānamupāviśan ||7|| kevalajñānasaṃbhūtisamākṛṣṭasurāgamāt | doṣādinātmakau kālāvabhūtāṃ bhedavarjitau ||7|| bhūmigocariṇo mastithā vidyāmahābalāḥ | upaviṣṭā yathāyogyaṃ kṛtvā kevalino maham ||79|| prasannamānasau sadyaḥ kṛtvā kevalipūjanam | praṇamya sītayā sākaṃ niviṣṭau rāmalakṣmaṇau ||8||
atha tatkṣaṇasaṃbhūtaparamārhāsanasthitau | praṇamya sāñjaliḥ padmaḥ papracchaivaṃ mahāmanī ||81|| kṣobhako prāpta ho gayā aura parvatakī caṭṭāneṃ hila uṭhīṃ ||66-67|| yaha saba ho rahā thā parantu una mahāmuniyoṃko isa vyarthakī ceṣṭākā kucha bhī bhāna nahīṃ thā, usa samaya unakā jñānopayoga antaraṃgameṃ śukladhyāna maya ho rahā thā athavā una mahāmuniyoṃkā jñāna karmoṃkā kṣaya karanevāle śukladhyānase tanmaya ho rahā thā ||68|| acche-acche puruṣoṃko bhaya utpanna karanevālā aisā vṛttānta dekha sītā nṛtya choḍa़ kāṃpatī huī patise lipaṭa gayī ||69|| taba rāmane kahā ki he devi ! he śubha mānase! bhayabhīta mata ho ! saba prakārakā bhaya dūra karanevāle muniyoṃke caraṇoṃkā āśraya le baiṭha jāo ||70|| yaha kahakara rāmane sītāko munirājake caraṇoṃke samīpa baiṭhāyā aura svayaṃ lakṣmaṇa kumārake sātha, yuddhake lie taiyāra ho gaye ||7|| tadanantara sajala meghake samāna garajanevāle evaṃ mahā kāntike dhāraka rāma lakṣmaṇane apane-apane dhanuṣa ṭaṃkore so aisā jāna paḍa़ā māno vajra hī choḍa़ rahe hoṃ ||72|| tadanantara 'ye balabhadra aura nārāyaṇa haiṃ' aisā jānakara vaha agniprabha deva ghabaḍa़ākara tirohita ho gayā ||73|| usa jyotiṣī devake cale jānepara usakī sabako saba ceṣṭāe~ tatkāla vilīna ho gayīṃ aura ākāśa nirmala ho gayā ||74||
___ athānantara parama hitakī icchā karanevāle rāma-lakṣmaṇake dvārā pratihārīkā kārya sampanna honepara arthāt upasarga dūra kiye jānepara donoṃ muniyoṃkī kṣaṇabharameṃ kevalajñāna utpanna ho gayā ||75|| tadanantara nānā prakārake vāhanoṃpara baiṭhe, harṣase bhare tathā tapake phalakī praśaṃsā karate hue cāroṃ nikāyake deva ā paha~ce ||76|| vahā~ vidhipūrvaka praṇāmakara tathā kevalajñānakī pūjākara saba deva loga hātha joḍa़e hue yathāsthāna baiṭha gaye ||77|| usa samaya kevalajñānako utpattise khice hue devoṃkā samāgama honese rāta-dina rūpa kāla bhedase rahita ho gayā arthāt vahā~ rāta dinakā vyavahāra samāpta ho gayā ||78|| bhūmigocarī manuṣya tathā vidyārūpī mahābalako dhāraṇa karanevāle vidyādhara-sabhī loga kevaliyoṃkī pūjākara yathāyogya sthānapara baiṭha gaye ||79|| prasanna cittake dhāraka rāma-lakṣmaṇa bhī sītāke sātha śīghra hī kevaliyoṃkī pūjākara yathāsthāna baiṭha gaye ||8||

anyadā prathitaḥ kṣoṇyāṃ gaṇeśo mativardhanaḥ | viharan padminīṃ prāpa śramaṇaḥ sumahātapāḥ || 95 || anuddhareti vikhyātā dharmyadhyānaparāyaṇā | mahattarā tadā cāsīdāryikā gaṇapālinī ||96|| vasantatilakābhikhye tatrodyāne susundare | saṃghena sahitastasthau caturbhedena sadbhuvi ||97|| adhodyānasya saṃbhrāntāḥ pālakāḥ kiṅkarā bhṛśam | nṛpaṃ vyajñāpayannevaṃ bhūmivinyastapāṇayaḥ || 98 || agrato bhṛguratyugraḥ śārdūlaḥ pṛṣṭhato nṛpa | vada kaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmo nāśo naḥ sarvathoditaḥ ||99||

185
athānantara kisī samaya munisaṃgha ke svāmī mativardhana nāmaka mahātapasvī ācāryaṃ pṛthivīpara vihāra karate hue padminī nagarī āye || 95 || usī samaya dharmaṃdhyānameṃ tatpara rahanevālī, atiśaya śreṣṭha aura āryikāoṃke saṃghakī rakṣā karanevālī anuddharā nāmakī gaṇinī bhī vidyamāna thīṃ || 96 || caturvidha saṃghase sahita mativardhana ācārya vahā~ ākara uttama bhūmise yukta vasantatilaka nāmaka udyānameṃ ṭhahara gaye ||97||
tadanantara udyānakī rakṣā karanevāle kiṃkara atyanta vyagra ho rājāke pāsa pahu~ce aura pṛthvīpara hātha rakhakara isa prakāra prārthanā karane lage ki he nātha! āge to baḍa़ī ū~cī ḍhālū caṭṭāna hai aura pīche vyāghra hai batāie hama kisakī śaraṇameṃ jāveṃ | hamārā to saba prakārase vināśa upasthita huā hai ||98-99 || 'bhale ādamiyo ! kyā ? kyā ??, kyā kaha rahe ho' isa prakāra rājāke kahanepara kiṃkaroṃne kahā ki he nātha! muniyoṃkā eka saṃgha udyānakī bhūmimeṃ ākara ṭhahara gayā hai ||100|| yadi isa saṃghako hama manā karate haiṃ to niścita hī śāpako prāpta hote haiṃ aura yadi nahīṃ manā karate haiṃ to āpako krodha utpanna hotā hai, isa prakāra hama logoṃ para baḍa़ā saṃkaṭa ā paḍa़ā hai || 101 || | he rājan ! āpake prasādase hama logoṃne vaha udyāna kalpavṛkṣoṃke udyānake samāna banā rakhā hai, usameṃ sādhāraṇa-pāmara manuṣya praveśa nahīṃ kara sakate || 102|| jo tapake tejase atyanta durgama haiṃ aise nirgrantha muniyoṃko deva bhī rokanemeṃ samartha nahīṃ haiṃ phira hamāre jaise manuṣyoṃkī bāta hī kyā hai ? ||103||
tadanantara 'bhayabhīta mata hoo' isa prakāra kiṃkaroṃko sāntvanā dekara bahuta bhārī āścayaṃse yukta huā rājā udyānakī ora calā || 104 || jo bahuta bhārī sampadāse yukta thā, bandījana jisakī stuti karate jāte the, tathā jo atiśaya pratāpī thā, aisā rājā calakara udyānabhūmimeṃ pahu~cā || 105 || vahā~ jākara usane mahābhāgyavān muniyoṃke darśana kiye| ve muni vanakī dhūlise vyāpta the, mukti ke yogya kriyāoṃmeṃ tatpara the tathā atyanta praśānta citta the || 106 || unameṃ se kitane hī muni donoṃ bhujāoṃko nīcekī ora laṭakākara pratimāke samāna avasthita the, tathā velā-telā ādi kaṭhina upavāsoṃse unake śarīra śuṣka ho rahe the || 107||

kitane hī svādhyāyameṃ tatpara ho bhramaroṃke samāna' madhuradhvanise gunagunā rahe the aura kitane hī svādhyāyameṃ citta lagākara padmāsanase virājamāna the ||108|| isa prakārake muniyoṃko dekhakara rājākā garvarūpī aṃkura bhagna ho gayā tathā usane hāthīse nīce utarakara muniyoṃko namaskāra kiyā| rājākā nāma vijayaparvata thā ||109|| bhogoṃmeṃ samīcīna buddhiko dhāraṇa karanevālā rājā krama-kramase saba muniyoṃko namaskāra karatā huā ācāryake pāsa pahuṃcā aura unake caraṇoṃmeṃ praṇāma kara isa prakāra bolā ki he naraśreṣṭha ! tumhārī śubha lakṣaṇoṃse yukta jaisī dīpti hai vaise bhoga āpake caraṇatalameṃ sthita kyoṃ nahīṃ haiṃ ?||110-111|| ācāryane uttara diyā ki tere śarīrameṃ yaha kyā buddhi hai ? ina aiśvarya ādikā jyoṃ-jyoṃ vicāra karo tyoṃ-tyoṃ ye atyanta duḥkhadāyī hī mālūma hote haiṃ ||114|| jo narakake samāna hai, atyanta bhayaṃkara hai, durgandhise bharā hai, kīḍa़oṃse yukta hai, rakta tathā kapha ādikā māno sarovara hai, jahā~ atyanta aśuci padārthoṃkī kīca maca rahī hai tathā jo atyanta saṃkīrṇa hai aise garbhameṃ isa jīvane anekoṃ bāra nivāsa kiyā hai, phira bhī mahāmoharūpī andhakārase āvṛta huā yaha prāṇī usase bhayabhīta nahīṃ hotā ||115-116| jo sarva prakārake aśuci padārthoṃkā bhāṇḍāra hai, kṣaṇa-bharameṃ naṣṭa ho jānevālā hai, jisakī koī rakṣā nahīṃ kara sakatā, jo kṛtaghna hai, mohase pūrita hai, nasoṃke samūhase veṣṭita hai, atyanta patalī camase ghirā hai, aneka rogoṃse khaṇḍita hai, aura buḍha़āpāke āgamanase nindita hai, aise isa śarīrako dhikkāra hai ||117-118|| jo manuṣya aise śarīrameṃ dhairya dhāraṇa karate haiṃ, caitanya arthāt vicārāvicārakī śaktise rahita una manuṣyoṃkā kalyāṇa kaise ho sakatā hai ? 189 rājño'nyasya sutā nāmnā śrīprabhā śrīprabhava sā | labdhā ratnaratheneṣṭā kanakāmāṅgajena ca ||153|| labdhā ratnarathenaiṣā tato dveṣamupāgataḥ | anundharo mahīṃ tasya vināśayitumudyataḥ ||15|| tato ratnarathenāsau vicitrasyandanena ca | nirjitya samare pañca daṇḍān prāpya nirākṛtaḥ ||155|| khalīkārāttataḥ pūrvajanmavairācca kopataḥ | jaṭāvalkaladhārī sa tāpaso'bhūd viṣādhivat ||156|| bhuktvā rājyaṃ ciraṃ kālaṃ sodarau tu prabodhinau| pravrajya sutapaḥ kṛtvā svargalokamupāgatau ||157|| tau mahātejasau tatra sukhaṃ prāpya surocitam | cyutau siddhārthanagare kṣemaṅkaramahībhṛtaḥ ||15|| utpannau vimalākhyāyāṃ mahādevyāṃ susundarau | deśabhūṣaṇa ityādyo dvitīyaḥ kulabhūṣaṇaḥ ||159|| vidyārjanocitau tau ca krīḍantau tiṣṭhatī gṛhe | nāmnā sāgaraghoṣaśca vidvān bhrāmyannupāgataḥ ||160|| rājñā ca saṃgṛhītasya tasya pārśve'khilāḥ kalāḥ | śikṣitau tāvudāreṇa vinayena samanvitau ||16|| 'svajanaṃ naiva tau kaṃcijānītastadgatātmako | kartavyaṃ hi tayoḥ sarva vidyāśālāgataṃ tadā ||162|| upādhyāyena cānītau sucirāt piturantikam | dṛṣṭā yogyau narendraṇa yathākāma sa pūjitaḥ ||163|| āvayoḥ kila dārārtha pitrā sāmantakanyakāḥ| ānāyitā iti śrotrapathaṃ vārtā tayorgatā ||16|| tatastau parayā ityā bāhyālī gantumabatau | vātāyanasthitāṃ kanyāṃ puraśomāmapaśyatām ||165|| tatsaṃgamārthamanyonyaṃ mānase'kurutāṃ vadham | tataśca vandino vaktrāditi śabdaḥ samutthitaḥ ||166||

- idhara ratnaratha aura vicitraratha donoṃ bhāī cirakāla taka rājya bhogakara prabodhako prāpta hae so dīkṣā le uttama tapa dhāraṇa kara svarga lokameṃ utpanna hue ||157|| mahātejako dhāraṇa karanevāle donoṃ bhāī vahā~ devoṃke yogya uttama sukha bhogakara vahāṃse cyuta hue aura siddhārtha nagarake rājā kṣemaṃkarakī vimalā nāmaka mahādevīke do sundara putra hue| prathama putrakā nāma deśabhūṣaṇa aura dūsare putrakā nāma kulabhūṣaṇa thā ||158-159|| vidyā upārjana karanekī yogya avasthāmeṃ vartamāna donoṃ bhāī gharapara krīḍa़ā karate rahate the| eka dina bhramaṇa karatā huā eka sāgarasena nāmakā mahāvidvān vahāṃ āyā, so rājāne use rakha liyā| utkṛṣṭa vinayase yukta donoṃ bhāiyoṃne usa vidvānke pāsa samasta kalāeṃ sīkhīṃ ||160-161|| donoṃ putroṃkā vidyāmeṃ itanā citta lagā ki ve apane parivārake logoṃko bhī nahīṃ jānate the| yathārthameṃ unakā sampūrṇa citta vidyā aura vidyālayameṃ hī lagā rahatā thā ||162|| upādhyāya cirakālake bāda pūtroṃko nipūṇa banākara pitāke pāsa le gayā so pitāne putroṃko yogya dekha upādhyāyakā yathāyogya sammāna kiyā ||163|| tadanantara pitāne hama donoṃke vivāhake lie rāja-kanyāe~ bulavāyī haiṃ yaha samācāra unake karṇamārga taka pahu~cā ||164||

āsanake kampita honese kṣubhita ho avadhijñānake dvārā saba jānakara yahā~ āpā hai tathā vyantara devoṃkī sabhāmeṃ baiṭhā hai ||179|| udhara tapasviyoṃkā ācāra pālana karane meṃ tatpara anundhara, śiṣya samūhake sātha vihāra karatā huā kaumudī nagarīmeṃ āyā ||180|| vahā~kā rājā sumukha thā aura ' 1. -bhiḥ sadvṛttaścittamuttamam ma. | 2. daigambarīm | 3. jaganmānyājinatīrthābhipūjitām ma. | 4. hāre ma. | 5. mṛtyum | 6. sarvadārabhya ma.|

ekonacatvāriṃśattamaṃ parva avaruddhā ca sacceṣṭā madaneti vilāsinī | patākā madaneneva jitvā lokamupārjitā ||182|| sādhudattamane pāśca samyagdarśanamaidasau| tatprāpyetaratīrthāni tṛṇatulyānyamanyata ||183|| tasyāḥ puro'tha rahasi kadācidavadannṛpaḥ | aho'sau tāpasa: sthānaṃ mahatāṃ tapasāmiti ||18|| tato madanayā'vāci kīdṛgnāthedṛśāṃ tapaḥ| mithyādṛśāmavijñānalokadambhanakāriṇām ||185|| tacchrutvā bhūpatistasyai kruddhaḥ sā cāgadat punaḥ | mā ruṣaḥ paśya nāthemaṃ me'cirātpādavartinam ||186|| ityuktvā svagṛhaṃ gatvā śikṣayitvā manoharam | ātmajāṃ nāgadattākhyāṃ preṣayattāpasāśramam ||187|| tasmai saikāntayātāya yogasthāya suvibhramā | āsthitāmarakanyeva paramākalpadhāriṇī ||188|| vāteritāmbaravyājādūrūkāṇḍamadarśayat | mārasyāntaḥpurasthānaṃ lāvaṇyarasanirbharam ||189|| samādhānopadeśena kuṅkumadravapiñjaram | māravāraṇakummābhaṃ tathā vakṣasijadvayam ||190|| kusumagrahaṇavyājāt trastanīvirateham | nāmimaṇḍalamuttejaḥ kakṣoddeśaṃ ca sundarī ||19|| ajñānayogametasya mittvā locanamānase | apaptatāṃ pradeśeṣu teṣu tasyāḥ subandhane ||192|| tāḍitaḥ smarabāṇaiśca samutthāya samākulaḥ | gatvā śanairapṛcchattāṃ tvaṃ bāle kāna vartase ||193|| saṃdhyākāle'tra ye kecit prāṇinaḥ bhadrakā api | ālayaṃ svaṃ niṣevante nanu tvaṃ sukumārikā ||19|| sābocanmadhurairvaṇaḥ mindantī hṛdayasthalīm | līlayā bāhulatikāmunnayantī mukhaṃ prati ||19|| calanololpalacchāye dhārayantī vilocane | kiṃcidanyamiva prāptā bahuvisphuritāgharā ||19||
ratavatī usakī strī thī jo saikaḍa़o striyoṃmeṃ pradhāna tathā parama sundarī thī ||181|| usī rājāke uttama ceṣṭāko dhāraṇa karanevālī eka madanā nāmako vilāsinī ( veśyā) strī thī, jo aisī jāna paḍa़tī thī māno saṃsārako jītakara kāmadevake dvārā prāpta kī huī patākā hī ho ||182|| usa madanāne sādhudatta munike pāsa samyagdarśana prāpta kiyā thā jise pākara vaha anya dharmoko tṛṇake samāna tuccha mānatī thī ||183|| athānantara kisī dina rājāne madanāke sāmane kahā ki aho! yaha tāpasa mahātapoṃkā sthāna hai ||184|| yaha suna madanāne kahā ki he nātha ! ina mithyādṛṣṭi, ajñānī tathā logoṃko ṭhaganevāle logoṃkā tapa kaisā ? ||185|| yaha suna rājā usake lie kruddha huā para usane phira kahā ki he nātha ! krodha mata kījie tathā ise mere caraṇoṃmeṃ vartamāna dekhie ||186|| yaha kahakara tathā ghara jākara usane apanī nāgadattā nāmakī sundarī putrīko sikhākara usa tāpasake āśramameṃ bhejā ||187||
